hf.title: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
hf.abstract: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI's pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding's substantial benefits for both, and OCR's potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.
hf.titleZh: GroundingPI:以视觉基元迈向物理智能的定位基础模型
hf.summaryZh: 现有 VLA 与世界动作模型多借用通用视觉语言或视频生成骨干做感知，在杂乱场景与小目标上定位精度不足，速度也难满足闭环控制。GroundingPI 把点与框表示为共享词表中的量化坐标，经多模态与空间预训练、监督微调与 GRPO 强化学习，训练出 4B 定位基础模型。在 34 个定位 benchmark、11 类感知能力上平均 73.68%，超过更大的 GPT-6 Astra(71.54%);作为视觉骨干，RoboTwin 2.0 四个分布外设定全部领先最强基线最多 24.8%,RoboCasa-GR1 用 50% 示范即超过用 75% 的基线，nuScenes 开环 L2 误差 0.296 米。作者还消融了预训练规模与数据配比，指出密集定位与 OCR 数据对感知学习的促进作用。
hf.reason: 含 GRPO 后训练的定位基础模型，但落点是机器人与自动驾驶等低分具身方向

hf.title: Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To
hf.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly ship with explicit "thinking modes", yet their counterpart, "no-thinking", has received far less attention. We study LLMs' no-thinking behavior along two axes. a. How to measure no-thinking? Prior work typically defines no-thinking through proxies such as a disabled thinking mode or the absence of long traces. These proxies are unreliable: disabled thinking modes may still emit reasoning, while long traces may contain filler rather than genuine inference. We instead normalize each response into a pre-answer trace and final answer, and evaluate it at three levels: (i) Empty-Thinking Rate for strict answer-only compliance; (ii) instruction-aware Question-Pre-answer Relevance for similarity between the question and pre-answer trace; and (iii) LLM-as-judge Explicit Inference Rate for visible explicit inference. Together, these metrics distinguish answer-only output, relevant but non-inferential text, and explicit inference. b. How does no-thinking vary across tasks and models? We evaluate six prompting interventions on six LLMs across Boolean, multiple-choice, and open-ended questions. We find that explicit no-think controls cannot reliably eliminate visible inference. Models instead exhibit "Thinking Inertia": explicit inference persists even under strict controls and becomes more prevalent as the answer space opens. Accuracy remains stable on Boolean and multiple-choice tasks, whereas open-ended tasks reveal a trade-off between answer-only compliance and task accuracy. Rewriting the same questions across answer spaces shows that supplying candidate answers makes answer-only responses easier to produce. These findings establish no-thinking as a non-trivial capability: stopping explicit reasoning cannot be assumed from model settings or instructions alone and deserves systematic evaluation alongside reasoning ability.
hf.titleZh: 思维惯性:当被告知不要思考时，LLM 仍会继续思考
hf.summaryZh: 针对「不思考」行为缺乏可靠度量的问题，把每条回复拆为前置推理痕迹与最终答案，提出三层指标:严格只答的空思考率、问题与前置痕迹的相关性、LLM-as-judge 判定的显式推理率。在 6 个模型、6 种提示干预及布尔、单选、开放三类任务上评测，发现显式禁用思考的指令无法可靠消除可见推理，即「思维惯性」，且答案空间越开放越普遍;布尔与单选题准确率基本稳定，开放题则在只答合规与任务准确率之间存在权衡，给出候选答案能提升只答合规率。这说明「停止思考」是一项需要系统评测的能力，不能仅靠模型设置或指令假定。
hf.reason: 推理控制与评测方法学，选题新但偏分析性实证

hf.title: AgentSWE: Can Coding Agents Build the Agent You Actually Want?
hf.abstract: As the production of software passes into the hands of software itself, coding agents are increasingly commissioned to build agents fitted to their users' own workflows. This delegation carries a quiet assumption, that the delivered agent will faithfully serve the requirement it was built for, rather than merely appear to. No existing benchmark tests that assumption. We introduce AgentSWE, a benchmark for agent software engineering spanning three stages of the agent development lifecycle: Creation of a complete agent from a natural-language requirement, Editing of production agent codebases, and Optimization toward a measurable target. Each of its 25 tasks is framed as a commission rather than an exam: the builder iterates against a handful of illustrative cases, while acceptance exercises the frozen submission on held-out cases designed to span the full requirement, grading behavior against requirement-derived rubrics under hard pass/fail gates or, for Optimization, against the source benchmark's own objective. Evaluating a range of coding agents across models and harnesses, we find that none comes close to delivering what a requirement asks for: the gap between what a builder demonstrates and what it delivers is the norm, not the corner case. An accompanying empirical analysis of the failure trajectories identifies recurring failure modes, among them overfitting to the visible cases, hollow runtimes behind code that looks complete, and unsupported claims of completion, each a signal by which coding agents can learn to build the agents they are asked for.
hf.titleZh: AgentSWE:编码智能体能否构建出你真正想要的 Agent?
hf.summaryZh: 针对「编码智能体被委托构建符合用户工作流的 Agent 时，交付物是否真的满足需求」这一缺乏评测的假设，提出 AgentSWE 基准，覆盖 Agent 开发生命周期的创建、编辑、优化三个阶段共 25 个任务。每个任务以「委托」而非考试形式呈现:构建者只对少量示例迭代，验收则在覆盖完整需求的留出用例上冻结提交，按需求推导的评分标准做硬性通过 / 失败判定，优化阶段直接沿用源基准的目标指标。在多模型与多种 harness 上评测后，没有编码智能体接近交付需求所要求的结果，「演示与交付之间的差距」属于常态;失败轨迹分析归纳出对可见用例过拟合、代码完整却运行时空心、无依据宣称完成等反复出现的失败模式。
hf.reason: 编码智能体构建 Agent 的评测基准，命中代码智能与 Agent 交叉

hf.title: Scaling Agentic Data for Long-Horizon Terminal Intelligence
hf.abstract: Terminal agents are moving beyond local operations toward completing real-world professional tasks. Short trajectories can demonstrate commands and tool calls, but they do not fully show how agents accumulate evidence through exploration, use it to inform judgments, continually adjust strategies based on feedback, and turn intermediate results into final deliverables. High-quality long-horizon trajectories capture these agentic behavioral patterns and their connections within a single problem-solving process, providing richer experience for sustained autonomous work. However, environment synthesis may complete or simplify the key work underlying these patterns in advance and thus remove the need for exploration, implementation, and verification that the agent was meant to perform. To address this, we introduce TerminalHorizon, a fully automated data synthesis engine for long-horizon terminal agents. Starting from real-world professional work, it uses independent execution to identify key work omitted during construction and uses the resulting evidence to guide environment reconstruction. To extend these patterns across stages, it progressively expands tasks under the same goal, introducing new requirements that build on prior results and call for further exploration and improvement. Using this engine, we construct 1.5K task environments and perform supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-27B on the resulting dataset to obtain TerminalHorizon-27B. We achieve substantial performance gains on all 12 benchmarks spanning coding-agent tasks, agentic tasks in real-world production settings, and general reasoning. Multiple RSI case studies, each with a 12-hour research budget, further demonstrate the model's ability to continue experimenting beyond an initial solution, improve its methods based on feedback, and retain effective improvements in its final deliverables.
hf.titleZh: 为长时程终端智能扩展 Agentic 数据
hf.summaryZh: 环境合成常把探索、实现与验证等关键工作提前简化，使长时程终端 Agent 轨迹难以体现证据积累与策略调整。为此提出全自动数据合成引擎 TerminalHorizon:从真实职业工作出发，用独立执行识别构建时被省略的关键工作并据此重建环境，再在同一目标下逐步扩展任务、叠加新要求以延续探索与改进。基于 1.5K 个任务环境对 Qwen3.5-27B 做监督微调得到 TerminalHorizon-27B，在编码智能体、真实生产 agentic 任务与通用推理共 12 个基准上均明显提升;12 小时预算的 RSI 案例显示其能超越初始方案、按反馈改进并保留有效改进。
hf.reason: 长时程终端 Agent 数据合成与后训练，直击 Agent 与 Agentic RL 方向

hf.title: VIS-Ground: Video Interactive Storytelling with Contextual Grounding
hf.abstract: Video interactive storytelling enables viewers to actively steer how a video unfolds. However, once we allow viewers to intervene during generation, a new challenge arises: The viewer's request can have latent dependencies on both the grounding source and the current rendered video state. These dependencies may not be explicitly stated in any individual input, but emerge only when the source, rendered history, and new viewer intent are considered jointly. Existing interactive video generation systems primarily emphasize following viewer instructions, while source-grounded video generation methods focus on aligning generated content with an external narrative or knowledge source. This leaves a fundamental question underexplored: What context should a generation model ground on during interactive continuation, and how can heterogeneous, unstructured inputs be transformed into such grounding context? In this work, we formulate contextual grounding as the process of transforming heterogeneous input context into an executable constraint model for video generation. To address this challenge, we introduce VIS-Ground, which performs Structured Context Abstraction to recover grounded states and cross-context dependencies, Generation Constraints Induction to project relevant dependencies into candidate-specific constraints, and Constrained Video Generation to enforce these constraints through planning, verification, revision, and rendering. Across three video generation backbones, VIS-Ground consistently achieves the highest overall composite score, reaching an average absolute improvement of 10.3 points over the strongest per-backbone baselines. Detailed analysis further shows gains across both narrative and knowledge grounding, and reveals remaining challenges in dependency extraction, and faithful realization during video rendering.
hf.titleZh: VIS-Ground：带上下文接地的交互式视频叙事
hf.summaryZh: 交互式视频叙事允许观众在生成过程中干预视频走向，但观众请求常隐含依赖接地来源与当前已渲染的视频状态，这些依赖不出现在任何单一输入中，只有联合考量来源、渲染历史与新意图时才浮现。VIS-Ground 把上下文接地形式化为将异构输入转化为可执行约束模型的过程，含结构化上下文抽象（恢复接地状态与跨上下文依赖）、生成约束归纳（把相关依赖投影为候选特定约束）以及约束视频生成（经规划、验证、修订与渲染落实约束）三个组件。在三个视频生成骨干上，整体综合分均达最高，较各骨干最强基线平均绝对提升 10.3 分，叙事接地与知识接地均有增益，同时暴露出依赖抽取与渲染忠实实现上的遗留难点。
hf.reason: 交互式视频生成，属不关注的视觉生成方向

hf.title: GroundAnything: Reconciling Parallel Decoding with Precise Visual Grounding at Flash Speed
hf.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) grounding models serialize spatial predictions, introducing sequential latency and imposing a causal order on output tokens. We view grounding as visual evidence extraction: objects, locations, and spatial relations are jointly constrained by the image and query, yet their dependencies do not imply an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. This distinction makes bidirectional diffusion a natural fit, allowing spatial hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be jointly refined through iterative denoising. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model that reconciles fast parallel decoding with precise localization through blockwise denoising. Training combines grounding pretraining from public datasets and dedicated data engines, direct AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint AR and diffusion objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement post-training. Across 30 grounding benchmarks, our autoregressive variant, GroundAnything-VLM, establishes a new overall state of the art among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%). With entropy-guided decoding, GroundAnything also surpasses the prior state of the art at this scale, averaging 61.75% versus 53.32% for the fast MTP-based LocateAnything model. We further explore decoding strategies, showing that an optional self-speculative mode achieves a 4.51times speedup over the AR counterpart with a 0.74 percentage-point drop in COCO F1mIoU. Infrastructure experiments show that progressive inference optimizations translate parallel decoding into practical speedups. These support efficient visual grounding in latency-sensitive real-world systems.
hf.titleZh: GroundAnything:以 Flash 级速度调和并行解码与精确视觉定位
hf.summaryZh: 自回归定位模型把空间预测序列化，带来串行延迟并对输出 token 强加因果顺序。GroundAnything 将定位视为视觉证据抽取，用块级去噪的双向扩散并行生成并联合细化空间假设，训练流程包含公开数据与数据引擎的定位预训练、带联合目标的 AR 到扩散直接转换、SFT 与基于 GRPO 的强化后训练。4B 参数的自回归变体 GroundAnything-VLM 在 30 个定位基准上以 72.42% 取得同规模最佳，接近 GPT-6 Astra 的 71.35%;熵引导解码下平均 61.75%，超过快速 MTP 方案 LocateAnything 的 53.32%，可选自推测模式相较自回归版本提速 4.51 倍，F1mIoU 仅下降 0.74 个百分点。
hf.reason: 多模态定位理解加 GRPO 后训练与并行解码加速，但扩散解码路径偏低分

hf.title: Multi-Stream Attention Residuals
hf.abstract: Attention Residuals (AttnRes) enables content-dependent retrieval over network depth, which can be viewed as single-stream softmax attention along the depth axis. Inspired by the success of multi-head attention along the sequence axis, we introduce Multi-Stream Attention Residuals (MSAR), an extension of AttnRes that generalizes this mechanism to multi-head depth attention, yielding substantial performance gains with minimal additional overhead. MSAR draws stream diversity from sequence context through multi-scale causal convolutions, allowing different heads to retrieve historical representations through distinct contextual views while preserving the integrity of the hidden representation. The retrieved streams are combined through lightweight adaptive mixing to generate the single-stream layer input. By retaining single-stream sources and expanding them on demand, MSAR supports multi-stream computation without requiring persistent multi-stream storage or communication. Across all 12 downstream benchmarks at the 18B and 28B MoE scales, MSAR consistently outperforms prior residual variants, including standard residual connections, manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC), and AttnRes. Scaling-law experiments yield an iso-loss compute speedup of 1.58times over the standard residual baseline, compared with 1.35times for AttnRes and 1.30times for mHC. These results make MSAR a promising residual architecture for large-scale pre-training.
hf.titleZh: 多流注意力残差
hf.summaryZh: 残差连接的形式长期固定，AttnRes把深度轴上的检索建模为单流softmax注意力，仍只有一条流。MSAR将其扩展为多头深度注意力：用多尺度因果卷积从序列上下文获取流的多样性，让不同head以不同上下文视角检索历史表示，再经轻量自适应混合还原为单流层输入；由于只保留单流来源并按需展开，多流计算不引入持久的多流存储与通信开销。在18B与28B MoE规模的全部12个下游基准上均优于标准残差、mHC与AttnRes，scaling law等损失算力加速达1.58倍，高于AttnRes的1.35倍与mHC的1.30倍，可作为大规模预训练的新残差架构。
hf.reason: 深度轴注意力残差新架构，18B/28B MoE实证扎实

hf.title: PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
hf.abstract: Language-model agents are usually trained by reinforcement learning from one reward per episode, and privileged self-distillation enriches it by letting the same policy, given a skill, teach its skill-free self through token probabilities. However, we identify two phenomena that question this channel. Invisible Advantage: a skill in context lifts WebShop success from 42.2% to 56.2%, yet changes the probabilities of fewer than a quarter of the sampled tokens. Much to Align: a skill changes the hidden states of over 80% of response tokens, in a way that linear probes can trace back to the specific skill. To exploit this, we propose Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation (PR-OPD). After a GRPO warm start, the policy writes a hindsight skill for each trajectory, re-reads its own responses with that skill as a stop-gradient teacher, and aligns its projected hidden states to the teacher's at every layer alongside the reward objective, with no external skill library, separate teacher, or inference overhead. On ALFWorld and WebShop with two backbones, PR-OPD achieves the best overall results in every setting, improving over GRPO by up to 4.7 points in ALFWorld success and 14.0 points in WebShop accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/balibata/PR-OPD.
hf.titleZh: PR-OPD:面向智能体强化学习的特权表征同策略自蒸馏
hf.summaryZh: 智能体RL通常每个episode只给一个奖励，特权自蒸馏用技能提示让策略教导无技能的自身，却只传递token概率层面的信号。作者发现:技能把WebShop成功率从42.2%提升到56.2%，却只改变不到四分之一采样token的概率;但它改变了80%以上响应token的隐状态，线性探针能追溯出具体技能。据此提出PR-OPD:GRPO热启动后由策略为每条轨迹写事后技能，以带技能的自身作停梯度教师重读响应，逐层对齐投影隐状态并保留奖励目标，无需外部技能库、独立教师或推理开销。在ALFWorld与WebShop两种骨干上均取得最佳结果，ALFWorld成功率较GRPO最高提升4.7分，WebShop准确率最高提升14.0分。
hf.reason: Agentic RL的自蒸馏改进，隐状态级特权对齐机制新颖，命中后训练方向

hf.title: Relevance Does Not Imply Applicability: Experience Activation for Personal GUI Agents
hf.abstract: Personal Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents rely on interaction history to infer what a user wants from ambiguous instructions and to anticipate recurring routines. Existing approaches retrieve task-relevant history and append it to the policy's context, implicitly assuming that experience relevant to a task remains useful for each decision within it. We find that this help is largely spent at the first decision: retrieved history strongly improves the opening step of an episode, yet provides little sustained benefit over the remaining 90\% of steps, and offers weak guidance on whether a proactive suggestion is warranted. A relevant record may tell the agent where to begin, but not which past action applies to the current screen or whether a routine is due now. The underlying issue is that relevance does not imply applicability}: relevance is determined at the task level, whereas applicability depends on the situation at decision time. We therefore recast personalization as experience activation and introduce ExpActivator, a training-free framework that activates only the experience applicable to the current situation. During execution, ExpActivator matches each new screen to historical states in the frozen GUI backbone's latent space and supplies the corresponding action as a reference. Before execution, it activates a recurring intent only when the current time and scenario provide sufficient support, and otherwise abstains. Across four GUI backbones, ExpActivator improves within-trajectory step success by 28\% on average, achieves the best personalized execution on every backbone while using about one-fifth as many history tokens, and reaches approximately 2.3times the Matthews correlation coefficient of the strongest proactive baseline. Experience pays where it is activated, not where it is appended.
hf.titleZh: 相关性不等于适用性:面向个人 GUI 智能体的经验激活
hf.summaryZh: 个人 GUI 智能体靠交互历史消解模糊指令、预判固定例程，现有方法按任务相关性检索历史并拼入策略上下文，默认相关经验对该任务每一步都适用。实测发现收益几乎只出现在 episode 第一步，对其余约 90% 的步骤无持续帮助:相关性在任务层面判定，适用性却取决于决策时刻的情境。免训练的 ExpActivator 在执行中将当前屏幕与历史状态在冻结 GUI 主干隐空间匹配，用对应动作作参考;执行前仅在时间与场景支持充分时激活周期性意图，否则弃权。四个 GUI 主干上轨迹内单步成功率平均提升 28%，历史 token 用量约五分之一，主动建议 MCC 约为最强基线的 2.3 倍。
hf.reason: GUI 智能体记忆激活，命中 Agent 记忆方向，免训练且多主干验证

hf.title: CrossTimeEdit: A Decade-Spanning Cross-View Dataset and Reward-Guided Editing for Historical Street-View Generation
hf.abstract: Historical street-view imagery records urban evolution, but uneven coverage leaves substantial gaps in historical records. Generating plausible past appearances requires restoring changed structures while preserving persistent scene content. We construct VIGOR-his, a decade-spanning cross-view dataset containing 43,653 location-level quadruplets across 11 cities on three continents. Its automated pipeline performs spatial pairing, consistency screening, change classification, and the generation and validation of satellite-based change descriptions and local editing instructions. Based on VIGOR-his, we propose CrossTimeEdit, a model that reformulates historical street-view generation as editing, using recent street views to constrain viewpoint and unchanged appearance and temporal satellite differences as change evidence. Starting from FLUX.2 [Klein] 4B, we train CrossTimeEdit through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by online reinforcement learning (RL). We design three street-view editing criteria, namely Instruction Alignment (IA), Background Preservation (BP), and Quality and Physical Plausibility (QP), as both RL reward dimensions and evaluation metrics. We optimize this multi-reward objective using Within Group Relative Policy Optimization for flow-matching models (Flow-GRPO) with Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO), which normalizes each reward dimension before aggregation. CrossTimeEdit improves overall performance across the three editing criteria by 17.12\% over the pretrained baseline and outperforms cross-view generation models in scene consistency, visual realism, and perceptual quality. The implementation code, dataset, and model weights are available at https://luhanwen67.github.io/CrossTimeEdit-release/.
hf.titleZh: CrossTimeEdit:面向历史街景生成的十年跨度跨视角数据集与奖励引导编辑
hf.summaryZh: 针对历史街景影像覆盖不均、缺失时段难以还原的问题，构建跨十年、覆盖三大洲 11 城、含 43,653 个位置级四元组的跨视角数据集 VIGOR-his，自动完成空间配对、一致性筛选、变化分类与编辑指令生成。CrossTimeEdit 将历史街景生成重构为编辑任务:以近期街景约束视角与未变外观，时序卫星差异作为变化证据;从 FLUX.2 [Klein] 4B 出发先 SFT 后在线 RL，以指令一致性、背景保持、质量与物理合理性三项准则作奖励，用 Flow-GRPO 配合 GDPO 分组归一化后聚合多奖励。三项准则整体较预训练基线提升 17.12%，场景一致性与感知质量优于跨视角生成模型。
hf.reason: 主体为街景图像生成，仅多奖励 RL 部分沾后训练边

hf.title: SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning
hf.abstract: When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. SpatialASM employs an allocentric novel-view generator to ground hypothetical viewpoints in visual evidence and produces two complementary forms of supervision: i) explicit ASM trajectories that teach LVLMs when and how to adaptively invoke view planning and imagination during spatial reasoning, and ii) automatically-constructed perspective-taking tasks that further strengthens viewpoint-conditioned scene imagination. On seven benchmarks spanning relatively perception-oriented spatial understanding to more challenging tasks requiring multi-image, cross-view and viewpoint-transformation reasoning, SpatialASM yields performance gain on LVLMs of four LVLM backbones in spatial reasoning while retaining their original general vision capabilities. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves average accuracy across the seven spatial benchmarks. And the synthesis of ASM trajectories provides a scalable pathway to alleviate the scarcity of spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision for eliciting active viewpoint exploration and mental scene simulation.
hf.titleZh: SpatialASM:内化主动心智化能力以实现空间推理
hf.summaryZh: 现有 LVLM 难以像人类那样在复杂空间推理中主动切换视角、在脑中重建场景布局。SpatialASM 通过训练期空间模拟把这种主动空间心智化(ASM)内化进模型:用异我中心的新视角生成器把假设视角锚定到视觉证据上，并给出两类监督——显式 ASM 轨迹教会模型何时、如何调用视角规划与想象，自动构造的视角采择任务进一步强化以视角为条件的场景想象。在覆盖感知型空间理解到多图、跨视角、视角变换推理的七个基准上，该方法在四种 LVLM 骨干上均提升空间推理准确率，同时保留原有通用视觉能力，也为缓解空间 Chain-of-Thought 监督稀缺提供了可扩展路径。
hf.reason: 多模态理解侧空间推理，方法扎实、结果可信，属画像内工作

hf.title: T3lescope: Arbitrary-Resolution High-Fidelity Generative Surface Reconstruction from Images
hf.abstract: We reconstruct high-fidelity 3D scene meshes from posed multi-view images without per-scene optimization, across scales ranging from single objects to large outdoor scenes. Per-scene optimization methods lack the learned 3D prior needed when observations are sparse or surfaces are glossy or transparent. Existing generative methods leverage such priors to complete geometry in sparsely observed regions, but typically operate at a fixed resolution over a limited spatial extent, trading spatial coverage against detail. Reconstructing a large scene therefore often requires partitioning it into independently processed overlapping local regions, making it difficult to maintain global geometric consistency. To address these issues, we propose T3lescope, which applies a single fixed-resolution generator across scene scales in an inference-time coarse-to-fine cascade. A coarse level establishes the scene layout, and finer levels perturb and denoise geometry inherited from the coarser level within progressively finer spatial cells to recover surface detail. The model is trained on individual cells at multiple scales and shares its weights across all levels, so no hierarchy is fixed during training, and the number of levels, cell scales, and cell locations are determined at inference time. On indoor, outdoor, and city-scale scenes, T3lescope outperforms feed-forward and generative baselines, matches or surpasses per-scene optimization, and recovers fine structures as well as glossy and transparent surfaces. These results show that our method generalizes across diverse scenes, view counts, and image resolutions. Project page: https://pfnet-research.github.io/t3lescope/
hf.titleZh: T3lescope:从图像出发的任意分辨率高保真生成式表面重建
hf.summaryZh: 从已标定多视角图像出发、无需逐场景优化重建高保真三维场景网格，痛点是稀疏视角或高光、透明表面下逐场景优化缺乏学到的三维先验，而现有生成式方法分辨率固定、空间覆盖与细节难以兼顾，大场景须分区处理导致全局一致性差。T3lescope 以单一固定分辨率生成器在推理时做由粗到细级联:粗层确定场景布局，细层在逐渐变小的空间单元内对继承几何做扰动与去噪以恢复表面细节;模型在多尺度的单个空间单元上训练并跨层共享权重，层级数、单元尺度与位置均在推理时确定。在室内、室外与城市级场景上，该方法优于前馈与生成式基线，追平或超过逐场景优化，并能恢复精细结构以及高光与透明表面。
hf.reason: 三维表面重建，属视觉重建低分方向

hf.title: Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation: Formulation, Benchmark, and Method
hf.abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) has largely focused on a single agent following a single instruction, yet many real-world applications require teams of robots to tackle tasks beyond the capabilities of any individual agent. We present Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation, providing, to our knowledge, the first systematic formalization of multi-agent VLN as a constrained coordination problem: each mission consists of subtasks carrying dependency and resource constraints (presence locks and holding chains). A verified four-stage crafting pipeline instantiates the task as MAVLN, comprising 11,724 episodes across 145 scenes with teams of up to four agents under three instruction regimes, accompanied by tailored constraint-aware metrics. We further present TRISS, a coordination-ready navigation system coupling an LLM-based subtask scheduler, a shared topological memory that turns each agent's exploration into team knowledge, and a conflict-aware execution mechanism that realizes simultaneous intentions as collision-free routes. Extensive experiments establish TRISS as a comprehensive baseline and reveal substantial room for improvement across scheduling, planning, and execution, highlighting the challenges of coordinating under MAVLN task constraints. Project page: https://xyz9911.github.io/mavln.
hf.titleZh: 系统化多智能体视觉-语言导航:形式化、基准与方法
hf.summaryZh: 单智能体单指令的视觉-语言导航(VLN)难以覆盖需要机器人团队协作的真实任务，该工作首次把多智能体 VLN 形式化为带约束的协同问题:每个任务由带依赖与资源约束(存在锁、持有链)的子任务构成。经四阶段可验证构造流程实例化出 MAVLN 基准，含 145 个场景、11,724 条任务，最多四智能体、三种指令模式，并配套约束感知指标。方法侧 TRISS 由 LLM 子任务调度器、把各智能体探索汇聚为团队知识的共享拓扑记忆、将并发意图转为无碰撞路径的冲突感知执行机制组成。实验显示 TRISS 可作综合基线，调度、规划与执行环节仍有明显提升空间。
hf.reason: 机器人导航与具身多智能体任务，属画像低分方向

hf.title: ARCS: Towards Precise Text-to-SQL via Structured Disambiguation
hf.abstract: As text-to-SQL systems move beyond demonstrations toward real-world deployment, ambiguity in user questions becomes a primary source of errors. Such ambiguities are often subtle, domain- or data-specific, and can silently cause system outputs to deviate from the user's true intent. Ambiguity is traditionally addressed through conversational clarification, which is often inefficient, cognitively demanding, and poorly aligned with real-world user workflows. We propose structured disambiguation, a new paradigm in which ambiguity is resolved through explicit, constrained interactions rather than free-form dialogue. We construct ARCS (Ambiguity Resolution Corpus for SQL), the first text-to-SQL benchmark featuring naturally occurring, unconstrained ambiguities over real-world databases, with complete annotations of all valid ambiguity points, interpretations, and SQL queries. Experimental results show that text-to-SQL remains challenging in the presence of ambiguity: gpt-6-sol achieves only 51% end-to-end execution accuracy, and no open-source model exceeds 27%.
hf.titleZh: ARCS:通过结构化消歧实现精准的 Text-to-SQL
hf.summaryZh: 真实部署中的 text-to-SQL 常因用户问题里的歧义而偏离真实意图，而传统的对话式澄清效率低、认知负担重。为此提出结构化消歧范式，用显式、受限的交互替代自由对话来消除歧义，并构建 ARCS 基准:基于真实数据库采集自然出现的无约束歧义，完整标注全部有效歧义点、解释与对应 SQL 查询。实验显示歧义场景下 text-to-SQL 仍具挑战:gpt-6-sol 端到端执行准确率仅 51%，开源模型无一超过 27%。该工作为歧义感知的 text-to-SQL 与交互式数据查询提供了可评测的基准与范式。
hf.reason: Text-to-SQL 消歧基准，贴合代码智能与评测方向

hf.title: Learning More by Training Less: Uncertainty-Guided Progressive Contraction for Efficient Reasoning Post-Training
hf.abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable advances in complex reasoning. However, scaling reasoning post-training with ever-larger corpora can substantially increase training cost without proportional performance gains. In this study, we therefore ask: how far can reasoning supervision be compressed without sacrificing capability? To this end, we propose an uncertainty-guided progressive contraction framework that concentrates supervision and optimization on the reasoning trajectories most valuable for learning. Specifically, rather than treating a teacher-generated chain-of-thought (CoT) as a single realized path, we construct uncertainty-profiled reasoning supervision by building Monte Carlo reasoning trees around intermediate reasoning states to expose process-level uncertainty. This uncertainty first contracts the original corpus into a compact teacher-informed pool. A second, learner-aware contraction then performs online routing during SFT, concentrating optimization according to the student's evolving learning state. Together, the two stages progressively contract both supervision and optimization, substantially reducing the student training budget. Experiments across diverse reasoning benchmarks and LLM families show that our method uses as little as 0.22% of the optimization budget of full-data SFT, over 450x less training exposure, while maintaining or improving reasoning performance. Notably, our framework generalizes well across heterogeneous student families, black-box teachers, and weak-to-strong transfer. This indicates that it is not only a way to accelerate training but can also enhance reasoning capability.
hf.titleZh: 少训多得：不确定性引导的渐进收缩用于高效推理后训练
hf.summaryZh: 针对推理后训练语料不断膨胀、训练成本上升却换不来等比性能增益的问题，该方法把教师生成的思维链视为一条采样路径，围绕中间推理状态构建蒙特卡洛推理树，以此刻画过程级不确定性。第一阶段用该不确定性把原始语料收缩成紧凑的教师信息池，第二阶段在 SFT 中做学习者感知的在线路由，按学生实时学习状态分配优化权重，从而同时压缩监督与优化。在多个推理基准与模型族上，仅需全量 SFT 优化预算的 0.22%、训练曝光减少逾 450 倍即可持平或提升推理表现，并可跨异构学生模型、黑盒教师与弱到强迁移泛化。
hf.reason: 推理后训练的数据与优化预算压缩，两阶段收缩机制新颖

hf.title: Initialization Improves LLM-Driven Discovery
hf.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used for novel discovery of algorithms, theorems, drugs, and other tasks through the use of harnesses that prompt an LLM to iteratively optimize an objective. In this work, we study the relationship between the population of previous iterates and eventual discovery success. We generalize past work on harness design to develop a suite of 12 harnesses called 'Modular' and characterize their performance across 5 diverse discovery tasks, finding that discovery success is brittle and sensitive to harness design. We uncover mode collapse, characterized by a dramatic drop in the diversity of iterates, as a common failure mode. We find that popular state-of-the-art harnesses and diversity-inducing harness interventions, which aim to prolong this collapse, yield inconsistent gains. Our results instead uncover that the performance of early discoveries is predictive of eventual success. We therefore propose a universally applicable intervention that performs an initial stage of parallel exploration in order to initialize subsequent iterative optimization. Our method provides consistent gains across many harnesses and target applications, confirming the importance of initialization in LLM-driven discovery.
hf.titleZh: 初始化提升LLM驱动的发现
hf.summaryZh: LLM驱动的算法、定理、药物等自动发现依赖harness反复迭代优化目标，但这类流程成功率脆弱、对harness设计高度敏感。该工作把既有harness设计推广为12种可组合的Modular套件，在5类发现任务上系统刻画其表现，识别出迭代多样性骤降的mode collapse是常见失败模式，并发现流行的多样性干预与SOTA harness收益并不稳定。分析表明早期发现的性能可预测最终成功，据此提出通用干预：先做一轮并行探索以初始化后续迭代优化，在多种harness与目标任务上获得一致提升，说明初始化是LLM驱动发现的关键变量。
hf.reason: AI for Research的harness与初始化机制研究，系统性强

hf.title: Visual Grounding Safety in Vision-Language Models
hf.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly trained to generate structured outputs like points and bounding boxes that downstream interfaces, agents, and robots can act on, yet safety alignment of this output channel has not been systematically analyzed. We study visual grounding safety by repurposing three safety benchmarks spanning direct harm (VLSU), social bias (BBQ-V), and situational safety (Asimov-2.0) into 15,401 matched pairs of harmful requests that differ only in the requested output: a free-text answer (VQA) or a grounding (point or bounding box). Across five VLMs, models that refuse a harmful request posed as a question often comply when the same request asks for a grounding: averaged over models, grounding refusal trails VQA refusal by 31-59 percentage points, depending on the domain, and safety system prompts do not close this gap. We propose a fine-tuning approach that combines grounding-form refusals with capability grounding data and self-distilled benign data to counter over-refusal. For Qwen3-VL-8B and VisionReasoner-7B, it improves grounding refusal by 77-95 percentage points on VLSU and BBQ-V and by 64-85 points on the held-out Asimov-2.0 domain, while also improving VQA refusal, preserving grounding capability, and keeping over-refusal limited. Representation analysis shows that fine-tuning moves harmful requests toward each model's refusal direction, most strongly for grounding, while leaving benign requests near the harmless reference.
hf.titleZh: 视觉语言模型中的视觉定位安全性
hf.summaryZh: VLM被训练输出点和边界框等结构化结果供下游智能体与机器人执行，但这一输出通道的安全对齐尚无系统分析。研究把VLSU、BBQ-V、Asimov-2.0三个基准改写成15,401组配对请求，仅改变所要求的输出形式(自由文本还是定位)，五个模型的定位拒答率比VQA低31–59个百分点。微调方案混合定位式拒答、能力定位数据与自蒸馏良性数据以抑制过度拒答，在Qwen3-VL-8B与VisionReasoner-7B上把VLSU/BBQ-V拒答率提升77–95个百分点，留出的Asimov-2.0提升64–85点，并保持定位能力。
hf.reason: VLM安全对齐新视角，聚焦定位输出通道拒答差异，实验系统扎实

hf.title: Branching On-Policy Distillation
hf.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but a single trajectory realizes only one continuation at each decision, limiting supervision coverage under a finite sampling budget. We propose BranchOPD (Branching On-Policy Distillation), which selects informative decision points using student uncertainty and teacher-student disagreement, resamples student-policy continuations from shared prefixes, and applies token-level teacher supervision to both main trajectories and branches. BranchOPD operates at token-level decisions in mathematics and within-turn decisions in agent tasks. Shared-prefix reuse reduces student-generated token costs by approximately 19% on ALFWorld and 31% on WebShop relative to seven independent trajectories. We also introduce protocol-boundary repair (PBR), which uses targeted supervision under protocol constraints to mitigate repetition and wasted generation. BranchOPD outperforms Vanilla OPD and Multi-Rollout OPD (n=7) across all evaluated benchmarks, with gains over Vanilla OPD of 18.55 percentage points in mean mathematics accuracy over 16 sampled answers (avg@16) and 13.8 points in mean ALFWorld ID/OOD success. Mechanistic analyses and selection ablations show that branching at uncertain decisions expands subsequent behavior coverage and outperforms random selection and turn-initial branching.
hf.titleZh: 分支式在线策略蒸馏
hf.summaryZh: 在线策略蒸馏(OPD)仅在学生自采样轨迹上施加教师监督，单条轨迹在每个决策点只实现一种延续，有限采样预算下监督覆盖不足。BranchOPD 用学生不确定性与师生分歧挑选信息量高的决策点，从共享前缀重采样学生策略延续，对主轨迹与分支统一施加 token 级教师监督，数学任务在 token 级、Agent 任务在回合内决策上分支，并用协议边界修复(PBR)抑制重复与无效生成。共享前缀复用使生成成本相对 7 条独立轨迹在 ALFWorld 降约 19%、WebShop 降约 31%;相比 Vanilla OPD，数学 avg@16 提升 18.55 个百分点，ALFWorld ID/OOD 成功率提升 13.8 点。
hf.reason: 后训练蒸馏方向，分支采样机制新颖，数学与 Agent 双验证扎实

hf.title: WOVEN: Weaving Visual World Modeling into Multimodal LLMs
hf.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with spatial, embodied, physical, and temporal reasoning. We hypothesize that these failures reflect a shared deficit in visual transition reasoning, and test whether this capability can serve as a shared training primitive, one that different models can learn from different supervision sources and reuse across different tasks, with a systematic training recipe. Existing benchmarks document these deficits separately but do not support controlled comparisons across scenes, actions, and reasoning operations. We therefore introduce WOVEN, a training source and benchmark for visual transition reasoning that organizes transition supervision by scene, action, and reasoning type, using diverse, realistic rollouts from video-pretrained generative models: 36,076 examples across 20 scene types, 5 action types, and 8 reasoning types. We first evaluate 38 frontier MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4 and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B) and find a substantial and systematic deficit: even the strongest models fall far below humans, and the failures recur across model families and persist with scale. We then train MLLMs at multiple scales on WOVEN and find that they learn a shared capability that transfers broadly: training subsets of only about 2,000 items each collectively improve 22 of 26 external benchmarks by up to 27.3 percentage points, and WOVEN data can replace 30-50% of a task's own training data with comparable accuracy. Controlled comparisons further yield a training recipe for visual world modeling, validated prospectively on held-out benchmarks: select supervision by the reasoning operation it teaches rather than by the actions, scenes, or domains it shows, and prefer larger changes to the visual state for robustness. Our work establishes visual transition reasoning as a reusable foundation for systematic visual world-model training in MLLMs.
hf.titleZh: WOVEN:将视觉世界建模编织进多模态大语言模型
hf.summaryZh: 针对多模态大语言模型在空间、具身、物理与时间推理上的系统性缺陷，把视觉状态转移推理当作可跨任务复用的共享训练原语，构建了按场景、动作与推理类型组织的训练数据和基准，含视频生成模型产出的 36,076 条 rollout。评测 38 个前沿模型发现其表现远低于人类且不随规模缓解。在 WOVEN 上训练的多尺度模型获得可迁移能力:各约 2,000 条的子集合计提升 26 个外部基准中的 22 个，最高 27.3 个百分点，还能替代任务自身 30–50% 的训练数据;对照实验给出按推理操作而非场景选择监督的配方，并在留出基准上前瞻验证。
hf.reason: MLLM 理解侧的训练原语与配方，数据与迁移结果扎实，命中关注方向

hf.title: Prospective Hindsight: Self-Calibrating Reinforcement Learning via Prediction-Reality Gaps
hf.abstract: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents relies on purely retrospective training signals: credit is assigned only after observing environmental consequences, leaving the agent's belief at action time invisible to the gradient. We introduce Prospective Hindsight (PH), a self-calibrating training principle that augments any retrospective base method with a signal derived from the gap between the agent's prospective prediction (before feedback) and the retrospective evaluation (after feedback). This per-rollout surprise identifies samples where the agent's self-model is most inaccurate and amplifies their gradient contribution through a stop-gradient surprise-weighted advantage. Since the prospective predictor shares parameters with the policy, the two co-evolve, progressively shifting focus to the agent's remaining blind spots. We connect this principle to a privileged-information gap and show that minimizing the surprise residual provides a descent pathway on the agent's miscalibration rate; calibration thus emerges as a byproduct of optimization rather than from an added objective. On single-turn verifiable tasks and a multi-turn personal-agent task (under GRPO, on-policy distillation, and their combination), PH improves both task performance and calibration, with consistent gains across model scales. Notably, the dominant miscalibration mode shifts structurally between regimes, overconfident failures in single-turn, underconfident successes in multi-turn, yet the same training principle addresses both successfully.
hf.titleZh: 前瞻性后见之明:通过预测-现实差距实现自校准强化学习
hf.summaryZh: 长程 Agent 的 RL 训练信号纯属回顾式，动作时刻的信念无法进入梯度。Prospective Hindsight 以前瞻预测(反馈前)与回顾评估(反馈后)之间的差距构造惊讶信号，用 stop-gradient 加权的优势项放大自模型最不准样本的梯度贡献，预测器与策略共享参数共同演化，焦点逐步转向剩余盲区。理论上该惊讶残差对应特权信息差距，最小化它即为误校准率提供下降路径，校准成为优化的副产品。在单轮可验证任务与多轮 personal-agent 任务上，叠加于 GRPO、on-policy distillation及其组合均同时提升任务表现与校准。
hf.reason: 后训练 RL 新范式，GRPO/蒸馏多设置验证，命中 Agent 与对齐方向

hf.title: Evaluating LLM Creativity through Long-Tail Performance
hf.abstract: Creativity benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) vary widely in task and metric design. This raises the question of whether they capture a common notion of creativity. We propose that this shared target can be formalized as task-specific performance in the long tail of a reference input-output distribution, which describes how common input-output pairs are relative to a chosen source of text. We ground this proposition in the novelty-quality product formulation and evaluate it empirically across 15 benchmarks and 26 open-weight models, using n-gram absence from the pretraining data as a novelty proxy. Our results show that creativity benchmarks lie further in the tail regions than standard benchmarks. Moreover, on both creativity and standard benchmarks, model rankings from higher-tail subsets of each benchmark align more closely with human creativity judgments in LM-Arena. Building on these findings, we introduce q@Tail(α), a lower-cost creativity diagnostic that measures mean task quality on the tail fraction of an existing benchmark. Applying it to creativity-promoting methods reveals substantial room to improve LLM creativity through stronger tail performance.
hf.titleZh: 通过长尾表现评估 LLM 创造力
hf.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 创造力评测任务与指标各异、缺少统一目标的问题，提出以参考输入输出分布长尾上的任务表现来刻画创造力，并用「新颖性×质量」乘积形式化，以 n-gram 是否出现于预训练数据作为新颖性代理。在 15 个 benchmark 与 26 个开源权重模型上验证:创造力 benchmark 比标准 benchmark 更靠尾部，且高尾子集给出的模型排序与 LM-Arena 人类创造力判断更一致。据此提出低成本诊断指标 q@Tail(α)，测量既有 benchmark 尾部区间的平均任务质量，结果显示 LLM 通过提升尾部表现仍有较大创造力改善空间。
hf.reason: LLM 创造力评测方法论，属评测方向但偏边缘

hf.title: Narrow Multimodal Fine-Tuning Can Induce Emergent Misalignment
hf.abstract: Modern AI models are aligned through post-training to adapt them to downstream tasks. Recent work shows that fine-tuning language models on narrow tasks can induce emergent misalignment (EM), causing broadly harmful behaviors beyond the training task. However, EM has been studied almost entirely in text-only tasks, leaving its manifestation in multimodal models unclear. In this paper, we define and analyze EM in the context of vision-language models. We first induce EM via fine-tuning on narrow multimodal tasks targeting vulnerable code, careless household-object use, and conspiratorial interpretations of ordinary scenes. Across fifteen commercial and open-source models with different scales, we find that narrow multimodal fine-tuning can induce coherent and broadly misaligned behavior that transfers to unrelated tasks, including misaligned opinions, visual factual dishonesty, unsafe image generation, vulnerability to visual jailbreaks, and risky agentic actions. We further find that multimodal EM does not depend on the apparent harmfulness of training data but is sensitive to training-evaluation modality alignment. EM can arise under both supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization and can propagate through intermediate reasoning. Finally, we explore several mitigation strategies, including prompt inoculation, benign continued training, and activation-level steering, which can partially reduce EM. Overall, our findings suggest that multimodal EM reflects a behavioral shift rather than a general loss of capability, extending beyond text to the visual modality.
hf.titleZh: 窄域多模态微调可诱发涌现性失准
hf.summaryZh: 定义并分析视觉语言模型中的涌现性失准（EM）：在针对脆弱代码、危险家用物品使用与对普通场景的阴谋论解读等窄域多模态任务上微调，可在 15 个不同规模的商用与开源模型上诱发连贯且广泛的失准行为，并迁移到无关任务，包括失准观点、视觉事实不诚实、不安全图像生成、视觉越狱易感与高风险 Agent 行为。EM 不取决于训练数据的表面有害性，而对训练与评测的模态对齐敏感；在 SFT 与偏好优化下均可出现，并能经由中间推理传播。prompt inoculation、良性续训与激活层 steering 等缓解手段只能部分降低 EM。结果说明多模态 EM 是行为层面的偏移，而非通用能力丧失。
hf.reason: 多模态后训练对齐新现象，系统性实验扎实，命中后训练方向

hf.title: UNITAS: A 3D-Native World Action Model for Embodied Manipulation
hf.abstract: World action models (WAMs) aim to answer a coupled physical question: given a task instruction, what motion should the robot execute, and how will that motion change the surrounding world? Most existing WAMs build on pretrained video generators and represent world evolution through images or visual latents. Robotic interaction, however, takes place in metric three-dimensional space, while images are view-dependent projections whose pixel distances do not directly encode physical distances. We introduce UNITAS, to our knowledge the first 3D-native world action model that unifies observations, actions, and scene dynamics in a shared metric 3D frame within each interaction, using a common representation across robot embodiments and human hands. Action flow represents human hands and robot grippers as 3D point trajectories, while scene flow describes scene-point displacements conditioned on these trajectories. World-aligned 3D positional embeddings ground visual tokens with or without depth input, and a physical-time trajectory tokenizer encodes each point trajectory as one token anchored at its current 3D position. This interface supports both direct action execution and action-conditioned scene prediction. With 1.7B parameters, UNITAS achieves the best action-conditioned scene prediction on RoboTwin among the compared methods, with up to 49% lower displacement errors than PointWorld, and state-of-the-art manipulation success, including 99.8% on LIBERO and an average of 85% across real-world tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/DexForce/UNITAS.
hf.titleZh: UNITAS：面向具身操作的三维原生世界动作模型
hf.summaryZh: 世界动作模型需同时回答给定指令下机器人执行何种动作、动作如何改变周围世界。现有方法多基于预训练视频生成器，以图像或视觉隐变量表征世界演化，但机器人交互发生在度量三维空间，像素距离并不直接对应物理距离。UNITAS 把观测、动作与场景动态统一在共享度量三维坐标系中：以三维点轨迹表示人手与夹爪的动作流，场景流描述以其为条件的场景点位移，并用世界对齐三维位置嵌入与轨迹分词器衔接二者。1.7B 参数下，其动作条件场景预测位移误差比 PointWorld 低至多 49%，LIBERO 成功率 99.8%，真实任务平均 85%。
hf.reason: 具身操作与机器人方向，画像中明确划为一刀切低分

hf.title: Same Output, Different Gold: Measuring How Reference Choice Moves a Multilingual Benchmark Score
hf.abstract: A benchmark score compares a system output against a reference, and methodological attention falls almost entirely on the first term. We measure the second. The retained annotation record of a six-language benchmark for personally identifiable information contains two independent annotator labellings, the aggregate shipped as gold, and a reviewer gold from independent expert re-annotation of a sample. Using it, we hold the scored output fixed and exchange the reference. The score moves by 4.95 F1 points for one output and 2.00 for the other (95% CIs [3.23, 6.27] and [0.26, 3.37]), and by 7.55 in the worst language. The comparison between two outputs moves as well: the paired interaction between reference and system is +2.95 points (CI [+1.97, +3.87]), survives correction for multiple testing, and changes one language's margin outright. The cause is an undocumented aggregation default that usually kept one annotator when adjudication did not fire, making the shipped reference a partial copy of an output being scored. We report the resulting reference-sensitivity band, show how to compute one from any retained annotation record, and argue that the quantity belongs beside the score.
hf.titleZh: 相同输出，不同金标:测量参考选择如何改变多语言基准分数
hf.summaryZh: 基准分数把系统输出与参考对比，方法学讨论却几乎只关注输出一侧。固定被打分输出、只替换参考，利用一个六语言 PII 基准保留的双标注记录、随包发布的聚合 gold 与专家复审 gold，测得单个输出分数变动 4.95 与 2.00 F1 点(95% CI [3.23, 6.27] 与 [0.26, 3.37])，最差语言达 7.55;两个输出之间的比较同样随参考改变，参考与系统的配对交互为 +2.95 点。根因是未文档化的聚合默认:裁决未触发时通常只保留一位标注者，使发布参考部分成为被测输出的副本。据此提出参考敏感度区间的算法，主张与分数并列报告。
hf.reason: 基准评测可靠性研究，命中评估方法学方向

hf.title: SPLATIFY: Reproduce, Discover, Innovate! From Papers and Ideas to Trainable 3DGS Code
hf.abstract: The rapid growth of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) research demands significant effort to reimplement papers before building on them. We introduce SPLATIFY, a multi-agent framework that converts 3DGS papers into trainable gsplat-based implementations, where generic paper-to-code methods and frontier models fail. SPLATIFY achieves this through five innovations: (1) A context-free grammar for gsplat over a modular method template with extension points for losses, densification, rendering, and optimization, constraining synthesis so generated code satisfies gsplat's architectural invariants by construction. (2) Architectural elements for faithful reproduction: fork-aware citation recovery retrieving component-level code at function-level granularity, Graph-of-Thought synthesis in topological dependency order, RAG-guided in-context example selection from over 20 verified implementations, and visual feedback combining PSNR-guided regeneration, Gaussian-level structural checks, and VLM-driven patching. (3) Knowledge-driven compositional improvement that autonomously finds weaknesses and composes complementary regularizers, losses, and densification strategies to improve upon original results. (4) Interdisciplinary method discovery where agents retrieve physical priors from outside the 3DGS literature and compose them with rendering knowledge to produce methods for previously unaddressed scene types. (5) SPLATIFY-Bench, an evaluation framework across 30 diverse 3DGS papers. On papers without public code, SPLATIFY matches expert implementations while reducing development time from weeks to minutes, and through compositional discovery further improves PSNR by up to 2.4 dB. We additionally demonstrate novel methods for volumetric nebula rendering and other scientific domains, synthesized entirely by SPLATIFY.
hf.titleZh: SPLATIFY:复现、发现、创新!从论文与想法到可训练的 3DGS 代码
hf.summaryZh: 针对 3DGS 论文复现成本高、通用 paper-to-code 方法与前沿模型难以产出可训练代码的问题，SPLATIFY 用多智能体框架把论文转成基于 gsplat 的实现:以 gsplat 的上下文无关文法约束模块化模板(损失、致密化、渲染、优化)，并配合分叉感知的引用恢复、按拓扑依赖序的 Graph-of-Thought 合成、从 20 余个已验证实现中做 RAG 示例检索，以及 PSNR 引导重生成、高斯级结构检查与 VLM 修补组成的视觉反馈。在无公开代码的论文上达到专家实现水平，开发周期由数周缩短到数分钟，组合式发现还能把 PSNR 再提升最多 2.4 dB，并自主合成出体积星云渲染等新方法。
hf.reason: 3DGS 论文到代码的智能体框架，方向擦边偏视觉重建

hf.title: HyperThink: Text-to-Parameter Hypernetworks for Efficient Reasoning
hf.abstract: Long-form thinking traces can substantially improve the multi-step reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), but they introduce high inference-time overhead, with latency dominated by sequential decoding. We propose HyperThink, a text-to-parameter approach that amortizes this reasoning computation into a single query-conditioned parameter update: a lightweight hypernetwork reads the question and predicts updates to a small subset of the base LLM's parameters, while a vector-quantized decoder constrains them to a finite set of reusable patterns to improve robustness and transfer. Trained end-to-end on outputs from the base model itself, HyperThink eliminates long thinking traces at test time: after one hypernetwork forward pass, the adapted model generates a concise step-by-step solution and final answer without an intermediate trace, using far fewer tokens while retaining strong reasoning performance. Empirically, HyperThink improves the low-latency region of the accuracy-latency trade-off on mathematical and general reasoning tasks, with its strongest gains in the near-non-thinking regime.
hf.titleZh: HyperThink：面向高效推理的文本到参数超网络
hf.summaryZh: 长思维链虽能提升 LLM 多步推理表现，却因顺序解码带来高昂推理时延。HyperThink 将这部分推理计算摊销进一次以问题为条件的参数更新：轻量超网络读取问题并预测基础模型一小部分参数的增量，向量量化解码器把增量约束到有限的可复用模式集合，以提升鲁棒性与迁移性，训练则端到端地使用基座模型自身的输出。测试时无需中间思维链，一次超网络前向即可让适配后的模型直接给出简洁分步解答与最终答案。在数学与通用推理任务上，该方法改善了精度与时延权衡中的低延迟区间，在接近「不思考」的区间增益最为明显。
hf.reason: 超网络生成参数更新以摊销推理，命中架构与后训练方向

arxiv.title: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
arxiv.abstract: Long-horizon agents have drawn growing attention for their ability to work autonomously -- from hours to days -- on economically valuable tasks, a capability essential to automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet open-source models still struggle on long-horizon tasks, largely for lack of both training data and a working recipe, and scaling both is hard: long, complex tasks are difficult to curate and verify, and their rewards are sparse. We address both. First, we introduce Tev-Gym, the first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable, dense, progressive rewards -- 1,170 verified task environments across 7 domains. It is built on a latent-world-first approach that first constructs a latent world: a complete and correct hidden specification of the task domain, workflow, and expected state after each step. Each task is then progressively rendered from this specification into an agent-facing environment, enabling controllable complexity and a natural progress metric. Second, we turn this metric into a training recipe: via progress-potential reward shaping (PPRS), we convert progress into a dense per-step reward that improves training efficiency and makes otherwise-intractable tasks trainable. Training with this recipe yields Tev-27B, which achieves substantial gains on the Agents' Last Exam computing and math sciences domains (ALE-CM), matching GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 at Pass@5. Despite training only on ALE-related data, it generalizes to the Terminal-Bench (TB) 3.0 and 4.0 subsets, surpassing GLM 5.2 and Gemini 3.7 Flash, and reaches Claude Opus 4.8-level performance on middle-horizon tasks such as TB 2.1.
arxiv.titleZh: Tev：用稠密进度奖励扩展长时程Agent环境
arxiv.summaryZh: 开源模型在长时程任务上仍显吃力，根源是训练数据与配方双缺：任务难筛选验证，奖励又稀疏。Tev-Gym以latent-world-first方式，先写出任务领域、工作流与每步预期状态的隐藏规格，再逐步渲染为面向Agent的环境，得到覆盖7个领域、1170个可验证环境的数据集与天然进度度量；progress-potential reward shaping（PPRS）把该度量转为逐步稠密奖励，使原本难以训练的任务可训。由此训练的Tev-27B在ALE-CM上Pass@5追平GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5，并泛化至TB 3.0/4.0子集，超越GLM 5.2与Gemini 3.7 Flash。
arxiv.reason: 长时程Agent环境合成＋稠密进度奖励，直接命中Agentic RL

arxiv.title: DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Reasoning models achieve strong performance through long chains of thought (CoT), but often spend more tokens than needed to solve a problem. Existing ways to shorten the CoT require additional training for each model, add a fixed steering vector to the model's hidden states, or use decoding heuristics such as stopping early or banning words like "wait", which can reduce accuracy. We propose DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method in which a much smaller reasoning model steers the large one towards brevity. The small model reads the large model's CoT so far twice, once prompted to be brief (the brief thinker) and once prompted to be verbose (the verbose thinker), and the difference between its two logit vectors, scaled by a strength, is added to the large model's logits at every step of the CoT. On seven benchmarks of competition mathematics, graduate-level science and competitive programming, DoubtLess shortens the CoT of Qwen3-32B by 31% with unchanged accuracy, outperforming five inference-time baselines. We also show that DoubtLess reduces thinking tokens per turn by 20% in a self-debugging coding agent with unchanged task performance. It also generalizes to two other model families with unchanged accuracy. When combined with training-based compression, it further shortens the CoT of a model already trained for brevity. Ablations and behavioral analysis show that DoubtLess reduces repeated checking, with most token savings coming after the correct answer first appears in the CoT. Our code is available at https://github.com/leoluolol/DoubtLess.
arxiv.titleZh: DoubtLess:面向高效推理的免训练对比解码
arxiv.summaryZh: 长思维链推理模型常生成远超所需的 token，而现有压缩手段要么需逐模型额外训练，要么在隐状态上加固定引导向量，要么用提前停止、禁用 wait 等启发式解码，往往损害准确率。DoubtLess 用一个小推理模型充当「简洁思考者」与「冗长思考者」两种角色，分别读取大模型已生成的思维链，将两者 logit 之差按强度缩放后加到每一步解码 logits 上，实现免训练的对比解码引导。在竞赛数学、研究生科学和竞赛编程七个基准上，Qwen3-32B 的思维链缩短 31% 且准确率不变，优于五个推理时基线;在自调试编程 Agent 中每轮思考 token 减少 20% 而任务表现不变，并可跨模型族泛化、与训练式压缩叠加使用。
arxiv.reason: 免训练对比解码压缩 CoT，后训练与推理效率方向扎实

arxiv.title: AesCode: Aesthetic Code Generation with Decoupled Cross-Modal Rewards
arxiv.abstract: Generating information-rich visual artifacts such as slides, posters, and dashboards as code is appealing because the outputs are structured, editable, and verifiable. Yet code models cannot see how their choices of layout and color come together on the canvas, often limiting spatial planning and aesthetic quality. Image generators excel at visual design but can misrender requested content, making their outputs unreliable targets for direct reproduction. We therefore introduce AesCode, which generates code grounded in the content prompt while using an image generated from the same prompt as an aesthetic guidance. To do so, AesCode represents the target as a design graph that describes the whole canvas and makes each property attributable. From this graph, we derive complementary cross-modal rewards: deterministic verifiers score properties parsable from code and rendering, while a VLM judge assesses the non-parsable ones with a sample-specific Visual Graph Rubric (VGR) tied to graph elements and relations. We optimize these decoupled rewards through reinforcement learning with per-channel normalization to jointly improve spatial planning, aesthetic quality, and verifiable correctness. To evaluate this setting, we build a benchmark that scores verifiable correctness and visual quality separately, with visual scores highly consistent with human judgments. We find that reference images substantially improve the visual quality of code generated by existing models, and ablations show that AesCode benefits from references both as model input and as a source of visual rewards. Relative to same-scale Qwen3-VL baselines given the same references, AesCode-8B and AesCode-32B improve visual quality by 31.1 and 22.4 percentage points, reaching scores comparable to those of closed-source frontier models such as GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8.
arxiv.titleZh: AesCode:用解耦跨模态奖励实现美学代码生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向幻灯片、海报、看板等信息密集视觉产物的代码生成，代码模型看不到所选布局与配色在画布上的实际效果，空间规划与美学质量受限，图像生成器的结果则内容不可靠、难以直接复现。AesCode 用同提示词生成的图像作美学引导，把目标表示为可逐属性归因的设计图，由此导出解耦的跨模态奖励:可解析属性由确定性验证器打分，不可解析属性由 VLM 评判器按样本专属的 Visual Graph Rubric 评估，再以带逐通道归一化的强化学习联合优化。新基准分别衡量正确性与视觉质量，视觉分与人类判断高度一致;同规模 Qwen3-VL 基线下 AesCode-8B/32B 视觉质量提升 31.1/22.4 个百分点，接近 GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8 等闭源模型。
arxiv.reason: 可验证奖励与 VLM judge 解耦的 RL 后训练，属代码智能扎实工作

arxiv.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
arxiv.abstract: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.
arxiv.titleZh: 混合推理智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 LLM Agent 只在文本空间推理，latent reasoning 内部高效却无法原生调用工具、也缺乏透明度。HybridAgent 在统一生成过程中动态切换两种模式：轻量 HybridLink 实现文本与潜空间的无缝转换，连续工作记忆跨轮保留无损混合上下文，使潜思考可直接检视；HybridSFT 稳定工具集成的混合生成，HybridRL 学习何时潜空间思考、何时文本行动。在 3 个规模、11 个覆盖数学、科学、医学、检索与智能体推理的基准上，平均提升 10.4%，token 减少 35.5%–54.7%，推理提速 1.8–2.6 倍，成本降低 2.7–3.7 倍。
arxiv.reason: 潜空间与文本混合推理加配套后训练算法，直接命中 Agent 与后训练方向

arxiv.title: Exact Topological Compliance: Generating Persistence-Equivalent Graphs
arxiv.abstract: Persistent homology summarizes the topological evolution of a graph as persistence diagrams (PDs). Generating graphs whose topology matches a target descriptor is increasingly important, yet existing topology-aware generative models rely on soft regularization, producing graphs whose PDs may only be approximately similar. We initiate a principled investigation of the generation problem: produce graphs that realize a target PD exactly. We propose two approaches guided by the implicit local and global constraints a target PD imposes. The local approach builds degree-based PD-equivalent graphs iteratively, and we prove that every output realizes the target PD and that every degree-based PD-equivalent graph is reachable. However, as shown thereafter, local generation necessarily trades off between sample diversity and reaching infeasible states. We therefore recast generation as a global constraint satisfaction problem with a complete encoding solvable by modern constraint programming solvers. This is applicable to any vertex-based permutation equivariant filtration scheme and is minimal under the degree filtration. Experiments on four standard graph generation benchmarks confirm that both methods realize the target PD exactly. Together, our methods provide a principled treatment of strict topology-compliant graph generation. Code is available at https://github.com/Aalto-QuML/ExactCompliance.
arxiv.titleZh: 精确拓扑合规:生成持久等价图
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对现有拓扑感知生成模型仅靠软正则、生成图的持久图(persistence diagram)只能近似匹配目标的问题，首次系统研究精确实现目标持久图的图生成。方法分两条路线:局部方法基于度数迭代构造持久图等价图，证明每个输出都精确实现目标持久图且所有基于度数的等价图均可达;因局部生成在样本多样性与不可行状态之间存在权衡，又把生成重铸为全局约束满足问题，给出可由现代约束编程求解器求解的完备编码，适用于任意基于顶点的置换等变过滤方案，并在度数过滤下达到最小。在四个标准图生成基准上，两种方法均精确实现目标持久图。该工作为严格拓扑合规的图生成提供了原则性处理。
arxiv.reason: 拓扑数据分析与图生成，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Two Clocks: Why Larger Rollout Batches Learn Slower but Fail on Schedule in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) relies on costly model-generated responses, motivating larger rollout batches and square-root learning-rate scaling. Reported to approximately preserve progress per sample with one optimizer step per rollout, this rule is less understood in practical multi-step training. We develop a two-clock framework that separates the samples needed to make progress from those consumed before collapse. Under a local quadratic model, the square-root rule preserves first-order drift per sample but not progress: larger batches take fewer, longer updates and lose more to curvature, yielding a learning-rate-dependent critical batch beyond which sample efficiency degrades. A drift-threshold hypothesis predicts a complementary failure clock whose sample count remains approximately invariant along the square-root rule. Controlled GRPO experiments on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B across a $16\times$ batch range support both predictions. Ratio clipping delays failure, especially for larger batches, but the progress gap persists without it. Widening the clip trades stability for a transient speed gain. The progress gap reappears on another dataset, a general-purpose checkpoint, and a 7B model. Finally, we use the two-clock framework to derive a simple multi-step RLVR schedule: start below the critical batch and switch to a larger batch before failure. Our code is available at: https://github.com/WinstonLiyt/two-clocks-rlvr.
arxiv.titleZh: 两个时钟:为何更大的rollout批量学得更慢，却会如期崩溃——可验证奖励强化学习中的批量与学习率缩放
arxiv.summaryZh: RLVR依赖昂贵的模型采样，常用更大rollout批量配平方根学习率缩放，但多步优化下该规则未必成立。作者提出双时钟框架，将取得进展所需样本与崩溃前消耗样本分离:局部二次模型显示平方根律只保住一阶漂移，大批量步数更少、单步更长，曲率损失更多，存在随学习率变化的临界批量;漂移阈值又给出样本数近似不变的失败时钟。Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B上跨16倍批量的GRPO实验支持两点预测，并在另一数据集、通用checkpoint与7B模型重现，据此导出先低于临界批量、再在崩溃前切换大批量的训练日程。
arxiv.reason: RLVR批量与学习率缩放分析，含理论框架与训练日程，命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: MFG: Multi-turn Feedback Guided Molecular Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Multi-objective molecular optimization is a critical process in drug discovery that aims to modify a given molecule to simultaneously improve multiple properties while maintaining a similar overall structure. This process often requires iterative modifications guided by computational or experimental feedback. Recent large language model (LLM)-based methods have begun to explore this iterative approach; however, these methods are not explicitly trained to leverage such feedback, while existing approaches primarily focus on single-turn molecular optimization. To address this gap, we introduce Multi-turn Feedback Guided (MFG) molecular optimization, a reinforcement learning framework that trains an LLM to progressively optimize molecules using feedback from previous turns. MFG introduces a feedback vector capturing both property improvements and source molecule similarity, alongside a feedback-aligned reward function that promotes progressive improvement across turns. We apply MFG over $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O}$, a state-of-the-art LLM model for multi-objective molecular optimization, evaluate $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O-MFG}$ on ten multi-objective molecular optimization tasks. The results demonstrate that $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O-MFG}$ achieves the highest average similarity-constrained success rate ($81.50%$), outperforming the base model $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O}$ ($70.81%$).
arxiv.titleZh: MFG:多轮反馈引导的分子优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对药物发现中的多目标分子优化——在保持整体结构相似的前提下同时提升多个性质，现有基于 LLM 的方法多为单轮优化，且未显式训练模型利用反馈。MFG 用强化学习训练 LLM 借助历史轮次反馈逐步改进分子，引入编码性质提升与源分子相似度的反馈向量，并设计与之对齐的奖励函数以促进跨轮渐进改进。在 GeLLM³O 上实现，十个多目标任务的平均相似度约束成功率 81.50%，高于基座模型的 70.81%。
arxiv.reason: 分子优化属生物医药垂直应用，仅借 LLM 后训练框架，相关度低

arxiv.title: Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement
arxiv.abstract: Robots are increasingly autonomous in task execution, yet their improvement remains largely human-driven. This study investigates Physical Recursive Self-Improvement (Physical RSI), in which physical experience guides lasting updates to both a robot's capabilities and its improvement procedure, making subsequent improvement more effective across tasks. Physical RSI faces challenges from noisy observations, continuous dynamics, costly trials, and irreversible consequences. We present an L0-L5 framework that differentiates capability-level from meta-level updates and within-task from across-task gains, reserving L5 for independently verified recursive gain. We study existing methods around harness adaptation and model training, alongside safety and control mechanisms that govern execution and successive updates. Our analysis reveals that, despite substantial progress in self-improvement, the surveyed literature does not yet demonstrate Physical RSI as defined by our framework. We identify research priorities in reliable feedback, causal attribution, safety preservation, and benchmarking, outlining a path toward robots that autonomously improve how they learn while ensuring safety. The GitHub repository for Physical RSI is available at https://github.com/SAIL-Research-Lab/Physical-RSI.
arxiv.titleZh: 谁来改进机器人?迈向物理递归自我改进
arxiv.summaryZh: 机器人任务执行日趋自主，但其能力改进仍主要依赖人工。该研究提出「物理递归自我改进」(Physical RSI)概念:物理经验既更新机器人能力，也更新其改进流程本身，使后续改进在跨任务场景下更有效。作者给出 L0–L5 分级框架，区分能力级与元级更新、任务内与跨任务增益，并将 L5 限定为经独立验证的递归增益，同时梳理了 harness 适配、模型训练以及约束执行与迭代更新的安全控制机制。分析表明现有文献尚未展示符合该定义的物理 RSI，并据此指出可靠反馈、因果归因、安全保持与基准测试四个优先研究方向。
arxiv.reason: 机器人与具身智能属低分方向，仅自我改进概念与 LLM 沾边

arxiv.title: Fast Rates for Offline Q-Learning with KL Regularization
arxiv.abstract: This paper investigates offline Q-learning for finite-horizon Markov decision processes with Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization. Recent studies have shown that KL regularization can yield fast rates in offline decision-making problems. However, it remains unclear whether Q-learning, which adopts incremental stochastic approximation updates, can achieve such fast rates in the offline setting. We first propose KL-regularized Q-Learning (KLQ), a simple variant of classical Q-learning. By exploiting KL regularization, we prove that KLQ achieves a sample complexity of $\widetilde{O}(1/ε)$ without explicit pessimism. This guarantee, however, has an exponential dependence on the KL regularization parameter and the horizon. To address this limitation, we further propose KL-regularized Pessimistic Q-Learning (KLPQ), which incorporates pessimism into KLQ. We prove that KLPQ retains the same \(\widetilde O(1/ε)\) rate while removing the explicit exponential dependence, thereby further improving the sample complexity. To the best of our knowledge, these results establish the first fast-rate guarantees for offline Q-learning in tabular finite-horizon KL-regularized MDPs.
arxiv.titleZh: 带 KL 正则的离线 Q-learning 的快速收敛速率
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对有限时程马尔可夫决策过程的离线 Q-learning，考察 KL 正则能否让增量式随机逼近更新也取得快速速率。先提出 KLQ——经典 Q-learning 的简单变体，借助 KL 正则证明其无需显式悲观即可达到 Õ(1/ε) 的样本复杂度，但该保证对正则参数与时间跨度存在指数依赖;随后提出引入悲观机制的 KLPQ，在保持 Õ(1/ε) 速率的同时消除指数依赖，进一步改善样本复杂度。这是表格型有限时程 KL 正则 MDP 下离线 Q-learning 的首个快速速率结果，属离线 RL 的理论分析工作。
arxiv.reason: 表格型 RL 样本复杂度理论，与 LLM 后训练无直接交集

arxiv.title: Scaling Online Optimal Transport Minibatches for Flow Matching
arxiv.abstract: A central challenge in scaling flow models is maintaining stability in training and integration. In flow matching, this stability depends critically on how source samples are paired with data. Independent random pairing introduces substantial stochasticity, motivating minibatch optimal transport (OT) to construct online source-target couplings that reduce this randomness (Tong et al., 2024). However, as applications extend to larger and higher-dimensional datasets, small minibatches can limit these benefits, while scaling the coupling to substantially larger minibatches at every iteration is computationally prohibitive. Moreover, how OT coupling affects the full stochastic gradient and integration remains theoretically unresolved. In this work, we develop a scalable online entropic OT approximation that enables substantially larger source-target couplings while preserving the benefits of OT. We close the theoretical gap for both unregularized and entropic OT by proving strict reductions in full stochastic-gradient variance and integration error relative to independent pairing, and further characterize how these improvements strengthen as the online coupling minibatch grows. Experiments on single-cell gene interpolation-flow and image-flow training validate these predictions, showing that larger online couplings consistently improve training stability and final generation performance.
arxiv.titleZh: 为流匹配扩展在线最优传输小批量规模
arxiv.summaryZh: 流匹配训练与积分过程的稳定性取决于源样本与数据的配对方式，随机独立配对会引入较大随机性，小批量最优传输(OT)可构造在线源—目标耦合以降低这种随机性;但当数据规模与维度增大时，小批量收益受限，而每次迭代都把耦合扩展到大批量在计算上又不可行。为此提出可扩展的在线熵最优传输近似，在保留 OT 收益的同时支持显著更大的耦合规模，并从理论上证明无正则与熵正则 OT 相对独立配对能严格降低全随机梯度方差与积分误差，且该改进随耦合批量增大而增强。在单细胞基因插值流与图像流训练上的实验验证了上述预测，更大的在线耦合持续提升训练稳定性与最终生成性能。
arxiv.reason: 流匹配属扩散式生成方向，与 LLM 关注点无关

arxiv.title: Read the Room Before Your Model Generates
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generally rely on sampling temperature to regulate the amount of randomness in their outputs. Mainstream methods for selecting temperature typically involve fixed, heuristic global settings and context or token-level calibration, rather than a geometrically interpretable representation of the communicative scenario. In this work, we introduce a simple and interpretable temperature selection framework, the \textbf{Scenario-Actor}, which adapts decoding to the inferred situational characteristics. Scenario-Actor extracts scenario-relevant structures from Transformer hidden states and determines the temperature from scenario embedding, a structured geometric representation of the communicative setting. Empirical results show that on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Scenario-Actor achieves strong goal-completion performance in interactive social scenarios, significant gains on open-ended instruction following, and competitive performance on multi-turn conversation compared to multiple baselines.
arxiv.titleZh: 生成之前先读懂场合:基于场景-角色框架的自适应解码温度
arxiv.summaryZh: 主流温度选择要么用固定的全局启发式设置，要么做上下文或 Token 级校准，缺少对交际场景的几何可解释表示。Scenario-Actor 从 Transformer 隐状态中抽取场景相关结构，再以场景嵌入(对交际情境的结构化几何表示)决定解码温度，从而让解码适配推断出的情境特征。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，该方法在交互式社交场景中取得较强的目标完成表现，开放式指令跟随有明显提升，多轮对话也与多个基线相比具备竞争力。适合关注推理期解码控制与生成可控性的工程场景。
arxiv.reason: 解码温度自适应，属推理期生成控制，方向擦边、增量改进

arxiv.title: Back-Translation Still Matters: Leveraging Monolingual Data for Low-Resource Machine Translation with LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Pre-trained Large Language Model (LLMs) are effective on many tasks in zero-shot and few-shot settings. For machine translation of low-resource languages, the obvious options are few-shot prompting and fine-tuning on a small parallel set. We ask: what if moderate amounts of low-resource monolingual data are also available? We argue that, rather than continued pretraining, a more effective use of this data is the pre-LLM era technique of back-translation (BT). The current fine-tuned LLM translates monolingual sentences in each language, and the resulting pairs train it in the reverse direction. Updates on the parallel set are interleaved for stable learning. With 1K parallel pairs on Odia and Swahili, BT beats continued pretraining into the low-resource language by 7.7 to 16.4 XCOMET-XXL points in domain. With beam-decoded intermediate translations, it also beats a model with 10 time more parallel data. In-context examples retrieved from the parallel data further improve BT. We also analyze the source, quality and amount of monolingual text. Across five low-resource languages, with Hindi as a high-resource control, and two 3B backbones, BT improves translation into the low-resource language by 16 to 173% XCOMET-XXL over parallel-only fine-tuning. Blind human evaluation on Odia and Sanskrit agrees with the automatic metrics.
arxiv.titleZh: 回译仍然重要:利用单语数据与 LLM 做低资源机器翻译
arxiv.summaryZh: 在只有少量平行语料、另有中等规模单语数据时，提出用回译替代继续预训练:让微调后的 LLM 翻译各语言的单语句子构造伪平行对，再训练反向翻译方向，并与平行集更新交替进行以稳定学习。仅用 1K 平行对，Odia 与 Swahili 域内比继续预训练高 7.7 至 16.4 XCOMET-XXL 分，中间译文用 beam search 解码时还超过平行数据多 10 倍的模型，从平行数据检索的 in-context 示例亦有增益。跨五种低资源语言、两种 3B 主干，相对仅平行微调提升 16 至 173% XCOMET-XXL,Odia 与 Sanskrit 的盲评人工结果与自动指标一致。
arxiv.reason: LLM 微调用于低资源翻译，与后训练 / Agent 主线仅擦边

arxiv.title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
arxiv.abstract: Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model--harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.
arxiv.titleZh: 自进化 Agent Harness
arxiv.summaryZh: 把模型权重冻结、只改 Agent 外围软件脚手架（提示词、记忆、工作流、可执行组件）的自进化过程形式化，被采纳的修改可跨运行持久保留。框架分离更新对象与提案、准入机制，区分解释性状态、工具与代码、仓库级控制逻辑和插件组合四类改动，以进化优化刻画搜索，用持续 PAC 学习分析可靠性，在显式假设下给出期望泛化界、受历史回归预算约束的保留界以及基于新鲜独立验证数据的高概率准入规则。已有案例展示了模型与脚手架协同设计、分布式执行与插件复用，并指出任务分布与评估器变化时须持续验证，对科学可靠性、物理安全与机构问责有直接影响。
arxiv.reason: Agent Harness 自进化与理论刻画，直击 Agent 与自我改进方向

arxiv.title: Statistical Vignettes on the Grokking Phenomenon
arxiv.abstract: In this work, we study grokking in a simple, analytically tractable setting whose rich phenomenology allows us to disentangle the effects of initialization, signal strength, weight decay, sample size, and input dimension. These factors can produce superficially similar learning curves through distinct mechanisms, complicating their interpretation. Our analysis distinguishes early fitting through nuisance features, core feature learning, and delayed generalization. We identify sharp conditions under which grokking provably occurs and derive analytic asymptotic expressions for the lengths of the generalization plateaus. Our results also characterize regimes of early generalization and failure to reach a prescribed test accuracy target. We show that the interpolation edge constitutes a distinct dynamical regime, where vanishing spectral gaps separate core learning from generalization, helping clarify the role of proximity to interpolation in existing accounts of grokking. The resulting picture is analogous to fast and slow phases in chemical kinetics and suggests that the lazy-to-rich transition discussed in the literature may reflect a similar separation of dynamical time scales. Our theoretical results are faithfully supported by extensive experiments.
arxiv.titleZh: 《Grokking 现象的统计小品》
arxiv.summaryZh: 在一个解析可处理的简化设定下研究 grokking，厘清初始化、信号强度、权重衰减、样本量与输入维度各自的作用，并区分「借 nuisance 特征早期拟合」「核心特征学习」「延迟泛化」三个阶段。工作给出 grokking 发生的严格条件以及泛化平台期长度的解析渐近表达式，同时刻画早期泛化与无法达到目标测试精度两类区域，并指出插值边缘是一个谱隙消失的独立动力学区间，从而澄清既有解释中「接近插值」的作用。整体图像类比化学动力学中的快慢相，提示文献中的 lazy-to-rich 转变可能源于动力学时间尺度的分离，结论由大量实验佐证。
arxiv.reason: Grokking 训练动力学理论分析，擦边预训练理论方向，非 LLM 直接相关

arxiv.title: Depth Memory
arxiv.abstract: Residual connections propagate information through a network by additively accumulating layer outputs. Recently proposed alternatives, such as Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) and Attention Residuals (AttnRes), instead use more expressive depth aggregation mechanisms that improve language modeling performance at scale.
