In this work, we consider the mixing of representations over depth as a problem of storing and retrieving information across layers. Formalizing this perspective, we introduce Depth Memory (DM), a unified framework that describes the standard pre-layer-norm (PreLN) transformer, mHC, and AttnRes in terms of streams that carry representations through the network. One such stream, for example, could be an explicit memory stream that is queried to enrich the input to every layer, and whose output is subsequently written back into the memory for use by later layers. For AttnRes, this memory stream is a growing cache of explicit layer representations. For mHC, it is an expanded residual stream. Building on this view, we propose Linear Depth Memory (LDM), which formulates information retrieval across depth as a regression problem solved using recursive least squares. The resulting architecture propagates three streams across depth: the standard residual stream, a linear associative memory stream, and an inverse covariance stream. For high-throughput training and inference, we propose a hardware-aware implementation of LDM that reduces peak activation memory and memory traffic. LDM consistently achieves the lowest perplexities among PreLN, mHC and AttnRes baselines at the 400M and 1.5B parameter scales, alongside competitive zero-shot accuracy.
arxiv.titleZh: 深度记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 残差连接以逐层加性累积的方式传递信息，而 mHC、AttnRes 等替代方案用更强的深度聚合机制提升语言建模效果。该工作把深度上的表示混合重新表述为跨层的存储与检索问题，提出统一框架 Depth Memory（DM），将 PreLN Transformer、mHC、AttnRes 统一描述为在网络中传递表示的若干条流，并据此提出 Linear Depth Memory（LDM）：把跨层信息检索建模为回归问题并用递归最小二乘求解，沿深度传播标准残差流、线性联想记忆流与逆协方差流三条流，同时给出硬件感知实现以降低峰值激活内存与访存。在 400M 与 1.5B 参数规模上，LDM 的困惑度一致低于 PreLN、mHC、AttnRes 基线，零样本准确率也具竞争力。
arxiv.reason: 提出深度记忆新架构，统一残差连接变体，直接命中预训练架构方向

arxiv.title: Optimizing Team Behavior via Extremum-seeking Control in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: In cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), agents must learn to coordinate their actions to achieve shared objectives. A key indicator of effective coordination is behavioral diversity, i.e., the agents' potential to enact distinct yet complementary control policies given the same set of observations. Although behavioral diversity can enable role specialization and richer joint behaviors, its appropriate level is highly context- and task-dependent and often costly to tune. We propose Adaptive Diversity Control (ADiCo), a two-timescale framework that adapts behavioral diversity online during training. On a fast timescale, Diversity Control (DiCo) regulates system diversity toward a target value. On a slower timescale, an Extremum Seeking Controller (ESC) adjusts this target using only mean episodic returns, without requiring an explicit model or analytical gradient of the diversity-performance landscape. We evaluate ADiCo on six configurations across two cooperative MARL tasks, where it maintains task-appropriate diversity levels: low diversity when homogeneous policies are beneficial and higher diversity when heterogeneous policies are required. Through this adaptation, ADiCo matches or exceeds the mean performance of DiCo (best grid-searched diversity target) and Unconstrained DiCo (diversity allowed to emerge without target regulation). These results demonstrate that incorporating classical feedback control into MARL training enables effective coordination by providing a systematic alternative to task-specific manual selection of the diversity target.
arxiv.comment: Accepted for publication at the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026), Hawaii, USA
arxiv.titleZh: 通过极值搜索控制在多智能体强化学习中优化团队行为
arxiv.summaryZh: 协作式多智能体强化学习中，行为多样性过高或过低都会拖累协调效果，而合适水平高度依赖任务、人工调参代价大。作者提出 ADiCo 双时间尺度框架:快时间尺度上由 DiCo 把系统多样性调节到目标值，慢时间尺度上用极值搜索控制(ESC)仅依据平均回合回报在线调整该目标，无需多样性—性能 landscape 的显式模型或解析梯度。在两个协作 MARL 任务的六种配置下，ADiCo 能按任务需要自动维持低或高多样性，平均性能持平或超过网格搜索最优目标的 DiCo 与不设约束的 DiCo，说明把经典反馈控制引入 MARL 训练可替代逐任务手工选参。
arxiv.reason: 经典控制与 MARL 的交叉，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 主线基本无关

arxiv.title: SkillScaffold: Scaffolding Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Policy-Adaptive Skill Credit Assignment and Selective Injection
arxiv.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from multi-turn interactions with verifiable outcomes. Textual skills can improve exploration by distilling prior interactions into reusable guidance. However, existing skill-based RL approaches often either assume skill injection is beneficial or rely on indirect feedback or rollout-intensive evaluation to assess its utility. Our pilot studies show that rollout-based utility estimation for skill credit assignment is costly and unstable under limited sampling, while skill benefits vary across candidates and depend on the current policy's competence on each query. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillScaffold, a policy-adaptive training scaffold that combines low-cost skill-utility estimation with selective skill injection. By reusing outcome-verified training trajectories, SkillScaffold generates candidate skills and estimates their utility through outcome-aware likelihood comparisons, without candidate-specific environment rollouts. The resulting utility guides whether and which skill to inject, retaining skill-free execution when no candidate is estimated to help. Joint training enables the Generator to produce skills tailored to the evolving Executor. Scaffolded RL encourages skill internalization for skill-free inference. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld, and $τ^2$-Bench demonstrate gains over strong agentic-RL and skill-based RL baselines across both short- and long-horizon tasks. Ablations and further analyses support the importance of utility-based selection and abstention. Our code is available at https://github.com/Vaidurya00/SkillScaffold.
arxiv.titleZh: SkillScaffold：以策略自适应技能信用分配与选择性注入为智能体强化学习搭建脚手架
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向多轮交互的智能体 RL，文本技能能提升探索，但既有做法要么默认注入技能必然有益，要么依赖间接反馈或大量 rollout 评估其效用，而试点实验显示这种评估在采样有限时既昂贵又不稳定，且技能收益随候选与当前策略在各 query 上的能力而变化。SkillScaffold 复用已通过结果验证的训练轨迹来生成候选技能，并通过结果感知的似然比较估计其效用，无需针对候选做环境 rollout，再据此决定是否注入以及注入哪一个，若无候选被判定有益则保持无技能执行；生成器与执行器联合训练使技能随策略演化而适配，脚手架式 RL 还鼓励技能内化以支持无技能推理。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 与 τ²-Bench 上，短与长时程任务均优于强智能体 RL 与技能型 RL 基线，消融印证了基于效用的选择与弃用机制的必要性。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL 技能信用分配与选择性注入，多基准验证，命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Where Do LLM Ensemble Gains Come From? Decomposing Candidate Value, Diversity, and Aggregation
arxiv.abstract: LLM ensemble gains are often measured against a single baseline, but the value attributed to additional candidates can change with the comparison used. We study an LLM aggregator under four matched conditions: Direct (no candidates), Single-slot (one candidate in a multi-slot interface), Duplicate (one candidate repeated), and Multi-candidate (separately generated candidates). Under either non-diverse control, overall candidate gain (CIV) splits algebraically into an additional-candidate contrast (DSV) and a candidate-context contrast (CCV); the split, but not CIV, depends on the chosen control. On MultiHopRAG model diversity (k=2), the repetition gap Rep=-8.33 pp [-13.25, -3.75] quantifies the difference between gains measured against Duplicate and Single-slot. On a matched FRAMES stronger-panel extension (n=200, k=3, aggregator output limit 4096), paired Delta Rep=+9.67 pp [+6.00, +13.50]; within panels, Rep changes sign (original -6.33; stronger +3.33). In FRAMES evidence aggregation, candidate-context contrasts remain strongly negative under both non-diverse controls. Our results show why ensemble evaluations should state the reference control before attributing gains to additional candidates.
arxiv.titleZh: LLM 集成的收益从何而来?拆解候选价值、多样性与聚合
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 集成收益常以单一基线衡量，但收益归因会随对照条件而变。该工作在 Direct、Single-slot、Duplicate 与 Multi-candidate 四种匹配条件下考察聚合器，证明非多样对照下总体候选增益 CIV 可代数分解为新增候选对比 DSV 与候选上下文对比 CCV，且分解(而非 CIV)依赖所选对照。MultiHopRAG(k=2)上重复差距 Rep=-8.33pp;FRAMES 更强候选组(n=200,k=3)配对 ΔRep=+9.67pp，组内 Rep 变号。故集成评测须先声明参照对照再归因增益。
arxiv.reason: LLM 集成评测方法学，擦边推理期多候选聚合与评估可靠性

arxiv.title: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
arxiv.abstract: Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: https://ethannju.github.io/carryon
arxiv.titleZh: 轻装前行(CarryOn):为长时程智能体构建面向对象的上下文
arxiv.summaryZh: 长时程智能体把进展保存在持久任务状态里，却仍反复处理描述进展如何取得的交互历史。CarryOn 是一个面向对象的上下文运行时，以可复用的任务对象作为延续基础，由 continuation carriers、补充执行上下文与近期交互的 live tail 共同构成上下文视图;核心难点在于历史退役后如何保持该基础有效，它跨 fold 维护 carrier 记录，依据绑定证据与环境检查只修订受影响记录、沿用未受影响部分，并联合更新执行上下文。在 OSWorld 2.0 与 BrowseComp-Plus 上分别取得 5.8% 与 7.0% 的提升，总 token 用量下降 51.9% 与 22.9%，适用于需要长时程记忆与上下文压缩的 Agent 系统。
arxiv.reason: 长时程 Agent 上下文与记忆管理，机制新颖且显著省 token

arxiv.title: BLADE: Auditing Information Use for Failure Attribution in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv.abstract: Large language model multi-agent systems extend individual agents' capabilities through collaboration across specialized roles, tools, and workflows. Yet collaboration makes failures harder to diagnose: one agent may misinterpret a correct result while others carry the mistake forward. Failure attribution therefore seeks to identify the responsible agent and decisive error step. Recent methods trace dependencies, but knowing where information came from is not the same as knowing where it went wrong. We introduce BLADE (Blame Localization via Audited Dependency Evidence), a training-free framework that moves beyond tracing information to auditing its use. Using Jev for structured probabilistic judgments, BLADE uses dependency probabilities to select relevant source-decision handoffs for auditing. At these handoffs, it examines whether receiving decisions use their sources faithfully and within task requirements, distinguishing error introduction, propagation, and repair. These findings inform a global diagnosis that considers all execution steps. Without reference answers, BLADE achieves the best or tied-best step accuracy among eight strategies under a shared Jev decision interface on 1,228 failed runs across five Who&When and Who&When Pro subsets, outperforming All-at-once by 2.2-11.1 percentage points. Making responsibility evidence explicit offers a path toward more interpretable and reliable agentic systems.
arxiv.titleZh: BLADE:面向 LLM 多智能体系统失败归因的信息使用审计
arxiv.summaryZh: 多智能体协作中的失败难以诊断:某个智能体误读了正确结果，后续智能体却把错误一路传递下去，而现有方法只追踪依赖来源，掌握信息从哪来并不等于知道哪里出错。BLADE 是免训练框架，借助 Jev 做结构化概率判断，按依赖概率选出相关的源决策交接点，审计接收方是否忠实使用来源并满足任务要求，从而区分错误的引入、传播与修复，再汇总成全局诊断。在五个 Who&When 与 Who&When Pro 子集的 1228 条失败轨迹上，统一 Jev 决策接口下其步骤准确率在八种策略中最佳或并列最佳，较 All-at-once 提升 2.2 至 11.1 个百分点。该方法把责任证据显式化，面向智能体系统的可解释性与可靠性。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体失败归因与信息审计，属 Agent 方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: Jeva: System One Models from First Principles
arxiv.abstract: System one models enable direct, low-latency decision-making. Yet recent practice of predicting an answer from serialized text does not, by itself, respect the structure of a decision problem. We argue that current designs underemphasize four important structural requirements. (i) null-aware: Models should distinguish answer absence from uncertainty among candidates; (ii) permutation-invariant: Reordering alternatives should not change the decision; (iii) option-scalable: Growing candidate sets should not require redefining the output space; (iv) cacheable: Request-independent computation over recurring alternatives should be reusable across requests. We introduce Jeva, a decision-native architecture that addresses these requirements jointly. A shared encoder independently represents the request and each option, while a compact decision stack refines only the request state against immutable option memory. Symmetric aggregation yields permutation-equivariant probabilities; shared scoring accommodates variable-size candidate sets. A separate coverage estimate distinguishes answer absence from candidate competition, enabling explicit null outcomes. Request-independent option representations and layer projections support reuse across newly assembled sets. These mechanisms unify Choice, Noul, and Score outputs. Across evaluations, Jeva combines strong typed-decision performance with near-perfect null detection and no decision flips under any tested permutations. It scales to thousands of candidates and substantially reduces latency through cross-request reuse without changing decisions.
arxiv.titleZh: Jeva:从第一性原理构建 System One 模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对把答案序列化为文本再预测、无法尊重决策问题结构的做法，提出决策原生架构 Jeva，共同满足四项结构要求:可识别空答案、排列不变、选项可扩展、可缓存。共享编码器分别表示请求与每个选项，紧凑决策栈仅针对请求状态相对不可变的选项记忆做精化，对称聚合给出置换等变概率，独立覆盖率估计区分无答案与候选竞争，统一 Choice、Noul、Score 三种输出。评测显示其兼具强类型化决策性能与近乎完美的空答案检测，任意测试排列下无决策翻转，可扩展到数千候选，并借跨请求复用显著降低延迟而不改变决策。
arxiv.reason: 决策原生新架构，与 LLM 仅间接相关，分量有限

arxiv.title: Rubrics from the Task, Verdicts from Evidence: Pointwise Rubric Rewards with Tool-Augmented Judges
arxiv.abstract: Rubric-based reward models (RMs) evaluate responses against explicit criteria. However, existing methods often derive criteria from observed response candidates, introducing response-induced bias that may limit rubric generalizability. Their judges also struggle with mechanical constraints when relying on reading alone, and commonly used pairwise judges provide only relative preferences, complicating their direct use for policy optimization. We propose ReVeR, a pointwise rubric RM that derives hard rules and graded principles by reasoning about the instruction alone and evaluates responses independently through tool-augmented judging. Both components are trained through label-blind distillation, in which preference labels only filter a teacher's outputs, yielding ReVeR-Traces, a large-scale dataset of rubric-reasoning and judging trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that ReVeR outperforms pairwise rubric RMs in average preference accuracy, most clearly on instruction following, as well as in test-time scaling and downstream policy optimization. We further find that generator RL improves preference accuracy while reducing rubric fidelity, and that higher preference accuracy does not necessarily translate into better downstream policies. These findings highlight that rubric fidelity, preference accuracy, and downstream utility are distinct properties, shedding light on future RM research.
arxiv.titleZh: 任务给细则，证据给裁决:工具增强评判器下的逐点式评分细则奖励
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有rubric奖励模型多从候选回答反推评分标准，带来响应诱导偏差;评判器仅靠阅读难以核验机械约束，成对评判又只给相对偏好，不便直接用于策略优化。ReVeR仅依据指令推理出硬性规则与分级原则，以工具增强的评判器独立逐点评估回答，两个组件均通过标签盲蒸馏训练，产出大规模轨迹数据集ReVeR-Traces。实验显示其平均偏好准确率优于成对rubric奖励模型，指令遵循提升最明显，测试时扩展与下游策略优化同样占优。研究还发现生成器RL提升偏好准确率却降低rubric保真度，且偏好准确率更高未必换来更好的下游策略。
arxiv.reason: 逐点式rubric奖励模型，直接命中RLVR与后训练方向

arxiv.title: Looking Complete Is Not Being Grounded: Evaluating LLM Sitreps Against Human-Authored Situation Reports
arxiv.abstract: Evaluation for automatic crisis reporting should measure what practitioners need, not what is convenient to compare. Through LLM-assisted, author-approved content analysis, we derive a 15-slot information schema from professional humanitarian situation reports using qualitative content analysis, then evaluate 121 human and 261 LLM-generated reports across five disasters and three hazard types. Under google/gemini-3.7-flash on Cyclone Idai, the best machine arm is nominally above the empirical human ceiling (0.827 vs. 0.821), but the difference is statistically indistinguishable from zero (95\% bootstrap CI $[-.049,.059]$; permutation $p=.852$), and the ordering does not replicate under openai/gpt-5.6-luna. On a blind 100-item Idai sample, the author agrees with the Gemini judge at 0.910 accuracy and unweighted Cohen's $κ=.799$. All four judges clear the plan's raw-agreement criterion of .7; only Gemini reaches .7 on chance-corrected $κ$. Across the three primary events, machine reports reproduce 5.4-11.0% of same-day official figures. Across those same events, raw exact-number matching links 14.3-19.6% of official figures and 85.4-90.1% of machine figures to the social stream; manual audit confirms 45/50 declared absences, 4/25 official matches, and 24/25 machine matches semantically. The issuing-provenance gap is positive in all 12 observed event-judge cells: report date, organisation, series, and authority were not supplied at professional-report coverage in any cell. On the three primary events, ROUGE-L is uninformative, BERTScore is negatively associated with completeness after multiplicity correction, and a generic LLM judge changes sign.
arxiv.titleZh: 看似完整并不等于有据：以人工撰写的态势报告为基准评测 LLM 灾情简报
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 自动生成的危机态势报告，主张评测应衡量实践者真正需要的信息，而非便于比较的表面指标。方法上用定性内容分析从专业人道主义态势报告提炼出 15 槽位信息模式，评估 121 份人工与 261 份 LLM 报告，覆盖 5 场灾害、3 类灾种。最佳系统在 Cyclone Idai 上名义得分 0.827 略高于人类上界 0.821，但 bootstrap 置信区间跨零、换用 GPT 后排序不复现，机器报告仅复现当日官方数字的 5.4–11.0%，出处信息普遍缺失。ROUGE-L 无信息量、BERTScore 与完整性负相关、通用 LLM 评委符号翻转，说明需面向领域需求设计评测。
arxiv.reason: 评测方法学（LLM 评委可靠性）相关，但属工作坊垂直应用，分量有限

arxiv.title: Beyond the Verdict: Agentic Code Judging with Verifiable Feedback
arxiv.abstract: Test-time scaling for large language models (LLMs) can involve generating multiple candidate solutions for selection or revising an earlier attempt. To guide selection and revision, we need a verifier that can estimate candidate correctness and provide evidence of failure. In competitive programming, however, official judging systems provide authoritative verdicts under finite submission budgets, without revealing failure explanations or failing inputs. To provide informative feedback without consuming official submissions, we formulate a task in which a model judges and diagnoses a candidate program using only the problem statement and source code, with generated counterexamples serving as checkable evidence. To evaluate this task, we build USACO-JUDGE from the USACO 2026 contests, using accepted and unaccepted programs written by human experts and multiple LLMs. We then train ARBITER, a 35B mixture-of-experts (MoE) agentic verifier, with reinforcement learning in a generic execution sandbox. Training raises counterexample success on incorrect programs from 40.61% to 62.67% and mean binary verdict accuracy on USACO-JUDGE from 71.41% to 87.41%, approaching frontier verification performance. Beyond verification, ARBITER outperforms baselines in both code selection and refinement. In an IOI 2026 case study, ARBITER-guided refinement raises GPT-OSS-120B's expected score above the gold-medal threshold under the official submission limit.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越判定之外:基于可验证反馈的智能体代码评判
arxiv.summaryZh: 官方评测在有限提交预算下只给出权威判定，不揭示失败原因与反例，难以支撑 test-time scaling 中的候选筛选与改写。该工作将其形式化为判定加诊断任务:模型仅凭题面与源码给出结论，并生成反例作为可检验证据;作者构建 USACO-JUDGE 评测集，并用强化学习在通用执行沙箱中训练 35B MoE 智能体验证器 ARBITER。训练把错误程序上的反例成功率从 40.61% 提升到 62.67%，二元判定准确率从 71.41% 升至 87.41%，在代码选择与改写上均优于基线;IOI 2026 案例中引导 GPT-OSS-120B 的改写达到金牌线以上。
arxiv.reason: Agent 代码验证 + RL 可验证反馈，命中 Agent、代码智能与后训练方向

arxiv.title: PreciseCoder: Faithful and Generalizable Debugging Beyond Unit-Test Rewards
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) from unit tests is the common recipe for post-training code models, but a unit test only asks whether the final program passes. We analyze what this unit-test-only reward teaches a model during debugging and find that, while it raises pass rates, it also teaches the model to edit more and to hallucinate bugs in code that is already correct. We introduce PreciseCoder, a training algorithm that augments the unit-test reward with a signal for semantically verified, localized edits, which correlates with smaller edits and higher pass rates. On 4B, 9B, and 27B models, PreciseCoder reduces the average number of edit lines from 7-15to 3 at a pass rate on par with unit-test-only training. Trained only on single-line bugs, PreciseCoder can generalize to repository-level program repair, where it resolves more issues with smaller patches. Its precision also transfers from weaker to stronger models: given the reasoning trace of a 9B PreciseCoder model, frontier models such as GPT-5.6 Sol and Qwen3.8-Max gain 4.6-12.4 points in edit precision with no additional training. Linguistic analysis of the thinking traces shows that our reward encourages the model to reason about individual lines, name the buggy ones, and form consistent bug hypotheses.
arxiv.titleZh: PreciseCoder:超越单元测试奖励的忠实且可泛化的调试
arxiv.summaryZh: 以单元测试通过率为唯一奖励的代码模型后训练，会诱导模型倾向于多改代码，并在本就正确的代码上幻觉出 bug。PreciseCoder 在单元测试奖励之外引入一条「语义可验证的定位编辑」信号，奖励小而准确的修改。在 4B、9B、27B 模型上，平均编辑行数由 7 至 15 行降至 3 行，通过率与纯单元测试训练持平;仅在单行 bug 上训练即可泛化到仓库级程序修复，以更小补丁解决更多 issue。该精度还可跨模型迁移:借助 9B 模型的推理轨迹，GPT-5.6 Sol、Qwen3.8-Max 等前沿模型免训练提升 4.6 至 12.4 点编辑精度。
arxiv.reason: 代码 RLVR 奖励设计改进，命中后训练与代码智能方向

arxiv.title: SolBehave: Evaluating the Behavioural Correctness of LLM-Generated Smart Contracts
arxiv.abstract: Large language models increasingly generate Solidity smart contracts that, once deployed, can never be patched, making a single latent fault permanent and exploitable. Yet current evaluations mostly ask only whether generated code compiles. We introduce SolBehave, a benchmark for evaluating the correctness of model-generated contracts at scale, moving beyond ad hoc unit tests. Across 250 real, reproducible Ethereum contracts, we apply three complementary tests of behavioural fidelity: differential fuzzing, historical-transaction replay, and, as our core contribution, synthetic-transaction replay guided by a Dynamic Condition Response (DCR) graph that enumerates the space of legitimate function-call sequences. Differential fuzzing compares each generated function with the original on automatically generated inputs; historical replay compares the whole contract on the transactions it actually received on-chain; DCR-guided replay compares it on sequences of calls that follow its intended usage, including orderings that never occurred on-chain. We evaluate seven state-of-the-art open-weight models after one round of automated repair. Compilation success ranges from 26.4% to 92.7%, but under differential fuzzing only 31.4% of all generated function bodies that compile, pooled over models and samples, are equivalent to the original. Divergence at the contract level is the norm rather than the exception: for six of the seven models, between 13% and 31% of the generated contracts that compile diverge from the original under historical replay, and between 13% and 44% under DCR-guided replay; only Gemma-4-31B stays below 3% on both. Compilation is therefore a necessary condition for correctness and far from a sufficient one.
arxiv.titleZh: SolBehave:评估 LLM 生成智能合约的行为正确性
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 生成的 Solidity 合约一经部署便无法修补，而现有评测基本只看能否编译。SolBehave 基于 250 个真实可复现的以太坊合约，用三项行为保真度测试衡量生成合约:差分模糊测试、历史交易重放，以及核心贡献——由 DCR 图枚举合法函数调用序列所引导的合成交易重放。七个开源模型经单轮自动修复后编译通过率为 26.4%–92.7%，但通过编译的函数体仅 31.4% 与原合约等价;六个模型有 13%–31% 的合约在历史重放中偏离原合约，13%–44% 在 DCR 引导重放下偏离，仅 Gemma-4-31B 两项均低于 3%。这说明编译通过只是正确性的必要条件，远非充分条件，可用于智能合约代码生成的可靠性评估。
arxiv.reason: LLM 代码生成正确性评测，方法有想法但属智能合约垂直方向

arxiv.title: A Rate Transfer Method: Convergence Rates in Stochastic Gradient Descent via Stochastic Calculus
arxiv.abstract: We develop a rate-transfer method that converts finite-time Lyapunov estimates for an associated stochastic differential equation (SDE) into finite-time convergence bounds for stochastic gradient algorithms. Under generic moment and smoothness conditions, the convergence analysis of the stochastic gradient method reduces to a calculus argument verifying a Lyapunov generator inequality for the SDE. The method recovers established rates for classical stochastic gradient methods and provides a way to establish convergence rates for new optimization algorithms through calculus arguments applied to their associated SDEs.
arxiv.titleZh: 速率迁移方法:通过随机微积分得到随机梯度下降的收敛速率
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对随机梯度类算法的有限时间收敛界难以统一推导的问题，提出「速率迁移」方法:把关联随机微分方程(SDE)的有限时间 Lyapunov 估计，转化为原算法的收敛界。在一般的矩条件与光滑性假设下，算法收敛性分析被归约为验证 SDE 的 Lyapunov 生成元不等式这一微积分论证。该方法能复现经典随机梯度方法的已知速率，并为新优化算法提供经由其对应 SDE 建立收敛速率的途径。适用于优化理论与算法收敛性分析。
arxiv.reason: 纯优化收敛理论，与 LLM 方向仅有间接关联

arxiv.title: Enabling Token-wise Importance Sampling in Off-Policy RLVR with Proximal KL Regularization
arxiv.abstract: Off-policy data in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can arise from asynchronous generation, rollout-training mismatch, and response reuse. Token-wise importance weighting avoids multiplying likelihood ratios across a response but generally biases policy gradients. We prove that, under coverage and local expressiveness conditions, full future KL credit makes the exact proximal optimizer the update's unique stationary policy, even for mixtures of older policies, without full-response weights or a fitted critic. We further establish convergence of continuous-time tabular population updates under persistent coverage and time-varying behavior policies, and a finite-sample reward guarantee for linear logistic models under additional assumptions. These results motivate Proximal KL, a practical off-policy RLVR method that separates the proximal reference from the sampling policy and replaces PPO clipping with bounded future KL credit. Across all seven matched off-policy comparisons on Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B, spanning two learning rates, response reuse, and rollout staleness, Proximal KL outperforms GRPO in micro-averaged accuracy over eight math benchmarks by up to 2.58%. A separate on-policy comparison yields comparable aggregate accuracy. In periodic-refresh experiments, Proximal KL avoids the collapses observed in PG and CISPO, exceeds GRPO's training accuracy, and reaches higher accuracy in fewer policy updates. Ablations show that token-wise correction outperforms sequence-level and unweighted controls. With token-wise correction retained, future KL feedback reduces sensitivity to the tested baseline perturbation relative to PPO clipping. A finite future horizon improves AIME24 mean@16 and pass@16 over the full tail, while fixed-policy measurements show that truncation reduces correction variance over the tested horizons.
arxiv.titleZh: 在离线策略 RLVR 中通过近端 KL 正则化实现 token 级重要性采样
arxiv.summaryZh: 离线RLVR的数据来自异步生成、rollout与训练不一致及响应复用，token级重要性加权避免整条响应似然比连乘，却引入梯度偏差。理论证明在覆盖与局部表达力条件下，完整的未来KL信用使精确近端优化器成为更新的唯一平稳策略，也无需整条响应权重或critic，并给出收敛性与有限样本奖励保证。据此提出的Proximal KL分离近端参考与采样策略，以有界未来KL信用替代PPO裁剪;在Qwen3-1.7B与Qwen3-4B的七组匹配离线对比中，八个数学基准的微平均准确率最高超GRPO 2.58%，在线对比聚合准确率相当。
arxiv.reason: RLVR离线策略与token级重要性加权的理论与实证改进，直击后训练核心

arxiv.title: SP$^2$ec: Adaptive Self-Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) has demonstrated its efficacy in accelerating large language model inference, but for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the diverse input modalities make it difficult for a small trained drafter to achieve consistently high throughput. Self-speculative decoding reuses parts of the target model as a drafter which retains the multi-modal capability of the VLMs, yet its efficiency depends on choosing a suitable draft configuration for each prompt. We propose Single-Peak SPeculative decoding (SP$^2$ec), a training-free bandit algorithm that adapts the draft configuration during generation. SP$^2$ec exploits the single-peak throughput pattern observed in existing self-speculative methods, including SWIFT, KnapSpec, SpecVLM, and our simple cosSim. Our algorithmic design explicitly minimizes a novel notion of wall-time regret for each given query, corresponding to the empirical wall-time latency. Theoretical guarantees on the wall-time regret show that SP$^2$ec can exploit the optimal draft configuration, with negligible exploration cost. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B across visual and textual tasks show consistent improvements of up to 11\% over the original self-speculative methods, demonstrating the wide applicability of the proposed SP$^2$ec algorithm.
arxiv.titleZh: SP$^2$ec:面向视觉语言模型的自适应自推测解码
arxiv.summaryZh: 自推测解码复用目标模型的部分层作为草稿模型，从而保留视觉语言模型的多模态能力，但其效率高度依赖为每个 prompt 选到合适的草稿配置。SP$^2$ec 提出一种免训练的 bandit 算法，在生成过程中在线自适应地调整草稿配置，利用了 SWIFT、KnapSpec、SpecVLM 以及所提出的 cosSim 等自推测方法共有的单峰吞吐模式，并针对每条查询显式最小化新定义的墙钟时间 regret，理论上保证以可忽略的探索代价逼近最优配置。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 与 LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B 上的视觉与文本任务实验中，相较原始自推测方法取得最高 11% 的一致提升，适用于多模态大模型的低延迟推理部署。
arxiv.reason: 自推测解码自适应调度，命中高效推理方向且带理论保证

arxiv.title: Learning When to Transfer: Reinforcement Learning for Carbon-Footprint Modeling in New Manufacturing Domains
arxiv.abstract: Manufacturers often need to characterize a new material, process, or product before enough operating data are available to train reliable predictive models for this new, target domain. Existing manufacturing operations contain potentially useful knowledge to accelerate this characterization, but indiscriminate reuse of data from existing source domains can cause negative transfer in learning of the new, target domain when the manufacturing domains differ sufficiently. This work proposes a reinforcement-learning method for selective knowledge transfer, where its reward scores each opportunity to transfer against supervised alternatives, so negative transfer is avoided and controlled during forward prediction instead of being diagnosed afterwards. Given limited data from a new target domain, the learned policy chooses among predictors based on individual source operations, subsets of the sources, or the supervised alternatives: fully pooled sources, or target data alone. A validation gate deploys the transferred prediction only when it improves upon the supervised alternatives. The method is designed for learning variables supporting carbon accounting, as well as performance and quality outcomes. We demonstrate the approach by quantifying the embodied greenhouse-gas emissions of parts produced via material-extrusion additive manufacturing, using data from 729 experiments spanning five materials: ABS, PETG, TPU, PLA, and recycled PLA. The response combines measured fabrication electricity with polymer-specific cradle-to-gate production factors, while 22 material, process, and toolpath features characterize each experiment. In leave-one-material-out evaluation, this method achieves a mean test RMSE of 5.2 g CO2e per part, 20.00% lower than target-only training (32.5% lower when only 5-10% of the target training data are available) and 10.30% lower than indiscriminate source-target pooling.
arxiv.titleZh: 学习何时迁移:面向新制造领域碳足迹建模的强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对新制造领域运行数据不足、盲目复用源领域数据会引发负迁移的问题，该方法用强化学习实现选择性知识迁移:奖励以监督学习基线为对照为每个迁移机会打分，策略可在单个源工序、源子集、全部源数据池化与仅用目标数据之间选择，并由验证门控仅在优于监督基线时部署迁移预测。以材料挤出增材制造的五种材料(ABS、PETG、TPU、PLA、再生 PLA)共 729 组实验验证，留一材料评估下平均测试 RMSE 为 5.2 g CO2e 每件，较仅用目标数据训练低 20.00%，较不加区分地池化源数据低 10.30%。适用于制造碳核算、性能与质量指标的跨领域小样本建模场景。
arxiv.reason: 制造碳足迹迁移学习，属垂直行业应用，与 LLM 方向基本无关

arxiv.title: On the Monitorability of Natural Language Autoencoders: Identification vs Discrimination
arxiv.abstract: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) are proposed as oversight tools for language models: an Activation Verbaliser (AV) writes an English explanation of an activation vector, and an Activation Reconstructor (AR) maps the explanation back to a vector. Their value for oversight depends on a human monitor being able to tell a true account of an activation from a false one, given the Av's explanation. We formalise NLA training and NLA oversight deployment as two different referential games from Emergent Communication: training is a generative referential game, while oversight is a discriminative, multi-modal, partially-observable referential game played over a many-to-many relation between the monitored language model's activations and the accounts that are true of them. The gap between the two games predicts that AV's explanations will identify which activation they describe without discriminating its true account from closely matched false ones, since training never asks explanations to rule anything out. Using the NLA's own AR as a maximally-sympathetic surrogate monitor model, we experimentally confirm this theoretical insight on one released checkpoint: true accounts beat accounts of other activations in all 320 comparisons, but beat fluent rivals differing in a single claim only 60.2% of the time (std.err. 6.7%, chance at 50%, $n = 35$). A meaning-preserving rewrite by an uninvolved model costs only 2.1% of the distance to another activation's account, so the failure is not due to the NLA pair having developed private conventions in the AV's explanations. Our rival accounts test only transcript-level truths, which the monitored language model's conversation settles, so these results bound the easiest case and leave claims about the monitored model's own processing untested. We state conjectures that would make both results consequences of the framework.
arxiv.titleZh: 论自然语言自编码器的可监控性:识别与判别
arxiv.summaryZh: 自然语言自编码器(NLA)是语言模型的监督工具:激活言语化器(AV)为激活向量写英文解释，激活重构器(AR)再把解释映射回向量，其价值取决于监控者能否据解释分辨激活描述的真假。该工作把 NLA 训练与部署形式化为涌现通信中的两种指称游戏:训练为生成式指称游戏，监督则是激活与真实描述多对多关系上的判别式、部分可观测指称游戏，两者落差使 AV 的解释只识别激活、不排除接近的虚假描述。以 NLA 自身的 AR 作代理监控者，公开检查点上真实描述在全部 320 次比较中胜出，但面对仅差一个陈述的流畅对手仅胜 60.2%(随机 50%,n=35)。
arxiv.reason: NLA 可监控性理论分析，属对齐与评估范畴，方向擦边

arxiv.title: Code-Switching Detection via Language-Selective Dimensions in Speech Foundation Models
arxiv.abstract: Code-switching (CS), the alternation between languages within an utterance, is common in multilingual speech but underrepresented in pretraining corpora. Increasing CS coverage requires finding relevant utterances in large speech collections so that they can be included in training data. One way to find such utterances is to transcribe the speech and detect language alternation in the text, but this depends on obtaining accurate multilingual transcriptions. We propose a lightweight method that detects CS directly from speech. It uses frame-level language information in pretrained speech encoders to determine whether both languages are present within an utterance. Specifically, we identify language-selective hidden-state dimensions using monolingual recordings and aggregate their frame-level activations into a CS prediction. With a small CS set used to tune a decision rule, we show that the Whisper-small encoder achieves a mean F1 of $0.798$ across 14 language pairs in CS-FLEURS, compared with $0.776$ for a CNN and $0.751$ for a HuBERT linear baseline trained for monolingual language identification. Our findings suggest that pretrained speech encoders already encode the information needed to identify CS utterances, and they provide a lightweight tool for building more representative multilingual corpora.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过语音基础模型中的语言选择性维度进行语码转换检测
arxiv.summaryZh: 多语言语音中的语码转换在预训练语料中严重不足，而扩增这类数据需要先在海量语音集合中找出混语语句。该工作绕开依赖准确多语言转写的文本路线，直接用语音编码器帧级隐状态中的语言信息判断一句话里是否同时出现两种语言:先用单语录音定位对语言具有选择性的隐藏维度，再把这些维度的帧级激活聚合为语码转换预测，并用一个小规模语码转换集调出决策规则。在 CS-FLEURS 的 14 个语言对上，Whisper-small 编码器取得平均 F1 0.798，高于 CNN 的 0.776 与单语语言识别训练的 HuBERT 线性基线 0.751，说明预训练语音编码器已隐含判别混语所需的信息，可作为低成本工具用于构建更具代表性的多语言语料。
arxiv.reason: 语音基础模型上的混语检测，属语音应用，偏离 LLM 关注方向

arxiv.title: Learning Source Structure: Bayesian Prediction with Transformers
arxiv.abstract: A transformer trained on sequences whose source parameters are drawn afresh each time can learn only what the sequences share: the source family and its prior. The Bayesian predictor that knows both, which we call informed Bayes, is the unique minimizer of the training loss and is computable from the family alone; we use it as a quantitative, falsifiable reference. Where earlier work compared transformers with Bayes on sources whose contexts can be learned independently, we build Markov sources with up to 64 symbols in which observations in one context inform prediction in another: product sources with known or hidden encodings, transition rows sharing an unknown base law and depth, and a mixture of three families. Our main result is that informed Bayes predicts, from the family and prior alone, how a trained transformer behaves in four tests that go beyond the learning curve: the loss that remains under a source outside the training family (predicted 2.237 bits, measured 2.309), the doubling of the extra loss when two independent components change rather than one (0.345 predicted, 0.350 measured), the benefit of other contexts when a token appears for the first time, and the depth at which copying an earlier continuation starts to pay. On the learning curves themselves, small transformers match informed Bayes when the shared structure is visible in the tokens, and hidden structure needs more layers and training, with gaps below 0.01 bits per token for the largest models. We explain why the imitation is possible and where it must fail: informed Bayes decomposes into sufficient statistics that attention selects and accumulates and an estimator, fixed by the prior, that the feed-forward network learns; training pays the complexity of informed Bayes under the architecture's prior, and finite-memory universal prediction bounds how closely a bounded network can reach it.
arxiv.comment: 45 pages, 12 figures. 9 pages of main text. Code at https://github.com/urbanke/learning-source-structure
arxiv.titleZh: 学习源结构:基于 Transformer 的贝叶斯预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究 transformer 能否学到序列背后的源结构:每条序列重新抽取源参数时，模型只能学到共享的源族与先验，同时知道二者的 informed Bayes 预测器是训练损失的唯一最小化者，可作为可量化参照。作者构造符号数达 64、上下文间相互提供信息的 Markov 源，并用四项超出学习曲线的检验验证该参照(族外损失预测 2.237 比特、实测 2.309;两个独立成分同时变化时额外损失加倍，预测 0.345、实测 0.350)。结果还显示结构可见时小模型即可匹配 informed Bayes，隐藏结构需更多层与训练，并给出注意力和前馈网络分别承担何种成分的解释。
arxiv.reason: Transformer 学习理论加合成 Markov 源，擦边预训练与可解释性方向

arxiv.title: Unlocking Token Rewards via Training-Free Reward Attribution
arxiv.abstract: In this paper, we propose an extremely efficient, training-free method to extract token-level reward signals directly from an existing deep reward model. Our core idea is to attribute the overall process reward to individual tokens by estimating each token's influence. This influence is defined as the change in the final macroscopic reward (e.g., the process reward) when a token is replaced with a semantically null token. Naively calculating this influence is computationally infeasible, requiring N forward passes through the PRM for an N-token sequence. We overcome this bottleneck by proposing a highly efficient gradient-based estimator. Specifically, we use a first-order Taylor approximation, which simplifies the influence calculation to the inner product of the difference between the token embedding and the null token embedding, and the gradient of the reward with respect to the token embedding. This requires only a single forward and backward pass. The resulting token-level rewards enable standard RL algorithms to perform precise credit assignment without requiring additional reward model training. Experiments on challenging reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method substantially improves policy optimization efficiency and enhances the generalization of LLM reasoning capabilities. Our P2T outperforms the outcome reward by +4.9% on MathVista for Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, and +11.5% on AIME24 for Qwen2.5-Math-7B. The code will be released via https://github.com/stonewst/P2T.
arxiv.comment: token-level reward, credit assignment, PRM, RL
arxiv.titleZh: 通过免训练奖励归因解锁 Token 级奖励
arxiv.summaryZh: 从已有的深度奖励模型(如 PRM)中直接提取 token 级奖励信号，无需任何额外训练。核心思路是把整体过程奖励按每个 token 的影响力归因，影响力定义为将该 token 替换为语义空 token 后最终宏观奖励的变化;朴素做法需对 N 个 token 的序列做 N 次前向，作者用一阶泰勒近似把影响力化简为 token 嵌入与空 token 嵌入之差和奖励对嵌入梯度的内积，只需一次前向加一次反向。所得 token 级奖励让标准 RL 算法完成精细信用分配，在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 上 MathVista 比 outcome reward 高 4.9%，在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 上 AIME24 高 11.5%。
arxiv.reason: 免训练 token 级奖励归因，直击 RL 信用分配痛点

arxiv.title: A Refresh Interval Does Not Fully Specify a Refresh Schedule: Learning-Rate-Dependent Placement in Kronecker-Preconditioned Language Model Training
arxiv.abstract: Kronecker-preconditioned optimizers recompute a cached curvature eigendecomposition only periodically, and implementations and adaptive methods control this through the refresh frequency. We show that frequency leaves part of a schedule free: at a fixed number of refreshes, when they occur changes held-out loss at the same compute. Training GPT-style models with the Mousse optimizer across model sizes, we move the middle refreshes of a four-refresh schedule while fixing the first and last. On FineWeb the two placements exchanged rank as the learning rate rose (later placement was better at low rates, earlier placement at high ones), so a single-learning-rate comparison can report either ranking. The reversal held under controls including the published optimizer internals, and placement still mattered at the published refresh density. The learning rate at which the preference flips fell with model size, consistent with a held-out smaller model, and shifted with training length. A spectral-width staleness score predicted the same ranking at every learning rate and missed the reversal. Refresh schedules should be reported in full and compared across the learning rates at which they will be used.
arxiv.titleZh: 刷新间隔并不能完全确定刷新调度:Kronecker 预条件语言模型训练中依赖学习率的放置位置
arxiv.summaryZh: Kronecker 预条件优化器(如 Mousse)只周期性重算缓存的曲率特征分解，实现中通常用刷新频率来控制。本文固定刷新次数、仅改变四次刷新中中间两次的位置，在 GPT 式模型与 FineWeb 上发现:同一计算量下放置位置会改变验证损失，低学习率偏好靠后放置、高学习率偏好靠前放置，排名随学习率翻转，单点学习率比较可能得出相反结论。翻转阈值随模型规模增大而下降，也随训练长度变化;基于谱宽的新旧度评分未能预测该翻转。作者据此建议完整报告刷新调度，并在实际使用的学习率区间内进行比较。
arxiv.reason: 优化器刷新调度研究，命中预训练优化与训练稳定性方向

arxiv.title: Knowing the User Is Not Knowing What We Established: Grounding Awareness in Personal Agents
arxiv.abstract: Personal-agent memory has largely focused on learning what users know, prefer, and want. However, knowing the user does not necessarily mean knowing what the user and the agent have established together. An assistant's proposal should not become an authorized instruction merely because it is remembered. We introduce Grounding Awareness, the ability to distinguish accepted, unacknowledged, revised, and scoped arrangements when selecting actions. We develop a controlled benchmark to test whether agents can tell the difference between proposals users have accepted and those they have not, and whether they apply accepted arrangements only where appropriate. Across multiple agents and memory systems, we find that strong memory performance does not ensure Grounding Awareness. More surprisingly, providing more complete user information can increase execution of unacknowledged proposals, while persistent memory can cause agents to treat these proposals as if they were user instructions. We trace these failures through memory writing, retrieval, and action selection. Finally, we introduce Grounding Layer, a lightweight, training-free extension that explicitly tracks grounding status and checks consequential actions, substantially improving agent behavior without modifying models or memory systems.
arxiv.titleZh: 了解用户不等于了解我们共同确立的内容：个人 Agent 中的 Grounding 意识
arxiv.summaryZh: 个人 Agent 的记忆研究多聚焦于学习用户知道什么、偏好什么，却忽略了「用户与 Agent 共同确立的约定」这一层。为此提出 Grounding Awareness：在选择行动时区分已接受、未被确认、被修订与限定范围的约定，并构建受控基准，测试 Agent 能否分辨用户已接受与未接受的提案、是否只在适当场景下应用这些约定。实验发现强记忆性能并不保证 Grounding Awareness，更完整的用户信息反而提高未被确认提案的执行率，持久记忆还会让 Agent 把提案误当作指令。免训练的轻量扩展 Grounding Layer 显式跟踪 grounding 状态并在关键动作前检查，不改动模型与记忆系统即显著改善 Agent 行为。
arxiv.reason: Agent 记忆与授权边界，属 Agent 方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: ProAS: A Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping Framework for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as the primary paradigm for optimizing Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet efficient critic-free algorithms (e.g., GRPO) suffer from a fundamental uniform credit assignment dilemma that broadcasts trajectory-level advantages equally to all actions. Our analysis reveals that this uniformity inherently reinforces structurally invalid actions in preferred trajectories and ignores the downstream cascading influence of early pivotal deviations in unpreferred ones. To resolve this without introducing critic overhead, we propose Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping (ProAS), a plug-and-play framework that leverages a dynamically evolving Agentic Reference Graph (ARG) to achieve fine-grained credit assignment via Masking Unreasonable Incentives (MUI) and Asymmetric Penalty Redistribution (APR). Extensive experiments across Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct demonstrate that ProAS universally elevates mainstream group-based baselines to new state-of-the-art performance, achieving peak success rates of 91.9\% and 94.3\% on ALFWorld, alongside 66.7\% and 70.8\% on WebShop, respectively. Furthermore, it accelerates training convergence by up to $2.44\times$ while maintaining strong robustness against imperfect or distilled ARGs. Codes: https://github.com/LINs-lab/ProAS.
arxiv.titleZh: ProAS:面向多轮 Agentic 强化学习的进度感知优势塑形框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 GRPO 等无 critic 算法把轨迹级优势均匀广播到所有动作、从而强化偏好轨迹中结构无效动作、并忽略非偏好轨迹中早期关键偏差级联影响的问题，提出即插即用的进度感知优势塑形框架 ProAS。它借助动态演化的 Agentic Reference Graph(ARG)，通过「掩蔽不合理激励」(MUI)与「非对称惩罚重分配」(APR)实现细粒度信用分配，且不引入 critic 额外开销。在 Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct 上，ProAS 将主流 group-based 基线普遍提升至新 SOTA,ALFWorld 成功率分别达 91.9% 与 94.3%,WebShop 达 66.7% 与 70.8%，训练收敛最快加速 2.44 倍，并对不完美或蒸馏得到的 ARG 保持稳健。
arxiv.reason: 多轮 Agentic RL 信用分配改进，直接命中后训练与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Model-Based Online Decision Making via Generative Trajectory Planning
arxiv.abstract: Online decision-making faces a tension between efficient inference and long-horizon reasoning. Value-based methods rely on short-horizon bootstrapping that limits the propagation of long-term information, while trajectory optimization methods plan explicitly but must solve a high-dimensional optimization problem at every decision step. We propose Generative Trajectory Planning (GTP), a model-based framework that addresses this tension by learning a generative model as a proposal distribution over action sequences. Instead of optimizing sequences from scratch, GTP samples candidate sequences from a diffusion prior and refines them using learned dynamics, reward, and value models, enabling efficient trajectory-level reasoning. Across continuous control and long-horizon manipulation tasks, GTP matches or exceeds state-of-the-art model-free, diffusion-policy, and model-based baselines, and remains stable in regimes where strong baselines degrade. Our results suggest that generative models are best understood not as policies, but as structured proposal distributions for planning, offering a new perspective on how to integrate generative modeling with model-based decision-making.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于模型的在线决策:生成式轨迹规划
arxiv.summaryZh: 在线决策在高效推理与长程推演之间存在矛盾:基于价值的方法依赖短视界自举，长期信息难以传播;轨迹优化方法显式规划，但每个决策步都需求解高维优化问题。GTP 学习一个生成模型作为动作序列的提议分布，从扩散先验采样候选轨迹，再用学到的动力学、奖励与价值模型迭代精修，以轨迹级推理替代从零优化。在连续控制与长程操作任务上，GTP 匹配或超越 model-free、diffusion-policy 与 model-based 基线，并在强基线退化的场景下保持稳定。其主张是生成模型更适合作为规划的结构化提议分布，而非直接充当策略。
arxiv.reason: 机器人控制加扩散规划，整体落在低分方向

arxiv.title: From Relation-Specific Heads to Shared Interventions: Contextual Entrainment in Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Large language models rely on prompt context to perform in-context learning, follow formats, and adapt to local evidence. This ability, however, also raises a robustness concern: models may reuse irrelevant tokens from earlier context when answering a later query. Prior work identifies this behavior as contextual entrainment and finds attention heads whose ablation reduces it, arguing that these heads are largely task- or relation-specific. But are the mechanisms behind contextual entrainment truly isolated by relation, or do relation-conditioned searches recover reusable components shared across relations? Using factual-distractor relation-completion prompts across 19 lexical-semantic subtypes, we identify attention heads whose ablation reduces entrainment and test how the resulting head sets transfer recovery ability across exact relations, semantic families, and mixed relation distributions. Same-family transfer exceeds different-family transfer, family residuals weaken once globally shared heads are removed, and subtype-specific searches repeatedly rediscover many global heads. Clean-completion and context-use probes further suggest that this shared intervention can reduce harmful copying while preserving ordinary relation completion and simple in-context abilities. Our findings provide a more precise perspective on contextual entrainment and its mitigation: harmful context following is not best addressed by searching for isolated relation-specific circuits, but by using heterogeneous attack prompts to reveal reusable intervention targets whose effects are shaped by semantic relation structure.
arxiv.titleZh: 从关系专属注意力头到共享干预:语言模型中的上下文诱导
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM回答后续问题时可能复用上下文中无关的token，这一现象被称为contextual entrainment，此前工作认为相关注意力头是任务或关系专属的。该研究在19个词汇语义子类上构造带事实干扰项的关系补全提示，用注意力头消融测试所得头集合在相同关系、语义族与混合关系分布间的迁移能力:同族迁移强于跨族迁移，去除全局共享头后族内残差明显减弱，子类专属搜索反复找回同一批全局头。干净补全与上下文使用探针显示，该干预在减少有害复制的同时保留了普通关系补全与简单上下文能力。结果提示缓解有害上下文跟随应寻找可复用的干预靶点，而非孤立的关系专属回路。

arxiv.title: SMI: Ontology-Grounded Semantic IDs for Hierarchy-Aware Medical Concept Representation
arxiv.abstract: Biomedical language models (LMs) provide strong representations for clinical tasks, but they often fail to capture the hierarchical structure among medical concepts. This limitation is especially pronounced for rare and fine-grained clinical codes in long-tailed vocabularies, where hierarchy-agnostic LM representations become less informative as concept frequency decreases. We introduce Semantic Medical Identifier (SMI), a training-free framework for constructing ontology-grounded Semantic IDs and hierarchy-aware medical concept representations. For each diagnosis, procedure, or medication concept, SMI defines its Semantic ID as the coarse-to-fine path through an expert-defined medical ontology. SMI then aggregates frozen biomedical LM embeddings across the corresponding ontology levels to form hierarchy-aware medical concept representations that preserve coarse-to-fine clinical semantics. The base SMI uses uniform aggregation across ontology levels, while a level-weighted variant selects global level weights on validation data. Our theoretical analysis shows that SMI yields more informative medical concept representations than hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings, particularly for rare and fine-grained clinical concepts. Experiments show that SMI captures meaningful hierarchical structure and improves clinical relation prediction. On MIMIC-IV, SMI improves mortality prediction, readmission prediction, drug recommendation, and rare drug prediction. On eICU, SMI yields more robust patient representations under cross-hospital distribution shift.

arxiv.title: Known-Voice Cloning and the Limits of Personality Transfer for Character Design
arxiv.abstract: Recent advances in zero-shot voice cloning systems make it possible to reproduce a recognizable voice from a short recording and attach it to arbitrary virtual characters. Prior work suggests that familiar vocal identity can carry over associated personality impressions to new targets such as robots or virtual characters. However, these works have mainly examined familiarity and personalization effects rather than directly testing whether a cloned familiar voice systematically transfers personality impressions to an embodied virtual character. Such transference raises the concern that cloned voices could be used to manipulate people into engaging with virtual characters as capable social actors. Across two studies, we investigated whether personality impressions transfer when a virtual character speaks with the cloned voice of a familiar person. Study 1 examined this question in a real-world university setting using the cloned voice of a lecturer familiar to the participating students. Study 2 examined the same question online using voices of social media content creators and members of their communities. Drawing on the concepts of identity activation, trait transfer, and person reconstruction, we show that evidence of personality transfer was limited in both studies. Observed effects were selective and did not generalize across traits or study contexts. In the online study in particular, recognizable voice identity cues activated expectations about the speaker but did not reconstruct the broader person impression. Qualitative responses further indicated that judgments were frequently shaped by perceived artificiality and by whether voice and appearance fit together. Our findings moderate common concerns that cloned voices straightforwardly manipulate people into perceiving artificial characters as capable social actors.

arxiv.title: BridgeTwist: Twisting Schrödinger Bridges for Training-Free Conditional Sampling
arxiv.abstract: Generative models are often required to serve many downstream conditional tasks. In the training-free setting, a pretrained unconditional model is reused as a prior and combined with a task-specific likelihood to sample from the corresponding posterior. While such training-free samplers have been developed for diffusion and flow models, their counterpart for Schrödinger bridge (SB) models remains unexplored, despite the growing appeal of SBs as flexible stochastic transport models between general source and target distributions. We propose BridgeTwist, a training-free conditional sampler for pretrained SB generative models, formulated as a tempered twisted sequential Monte Carlo scheme. Its twist is a closed-form plug-in surrogate, obtained by combining the velocity and score fields exposed by SB pretraining into an endpoint predictor and evaluating the likelihood there. Since this surrogate is less reliable near the source, we temper the twist with a time-varying exponent, downweighting its influence at early steps. We further introduce a bridge-shaped inference-time diffusion schedule that concentrates the proposal noise in the interior of the path. Telescoping importance weights then cancel all intermediate twist factors, yielding an asymptotically exact sampler for the posterior. Empirically, BridgeTwist outperforms training-free baselines on class-conditional and text-prompted image generation, and is competitive with specialized inverse problem solvers on inpainting, deblurring, and super-resolution.

arxiv.title: Bayesian Test-Time Inference of Task-Aligned Similarity from Weak Interactive Feedback
arxiv.abstract: Language model systems repeatedly make test-time decisions by comparing similarity: they retrieve exemplars, rank candidates, and revise responses. Yet similarity is not unique: lexical, semantic, structural, and stylistic resemblance can point to different candidates, and the task-aligned notion can change across instances. We introduce BASIS (Bayesian Axis Selection via Interactive Signals), a training-free Bayesian method that uses weak test-time feedback to infer which criterion in a supplied, task-specific library governs the current decision. It maintains a joint posterior over candidate targets and criteria, updates it from scalar scores, pairwise preferences, or verifier outputs, and selects probes by expected information gain. In a finite noisy model, we characterize when the target-criterion pair is recoverable and show why fixed-criterion and fixed-mixture rules can fail under criterion shift. Across concept recovery, reasoning exemplar selection, and response refinement, BASIS improves six-probe concept-recovery Success@1 from 56.0% to 68.1%, reasoning accuracy from 72.3% to 73.1%, and refinement win rate from 61.4% to 63.8% over tuned static mixtures. It also exceeds compute-matched best-of-N selection on reasoning (72.1%) and refinement (61.2%). Gains are largest under criterion mismatch and with larger candidate pools, and matched controls indicate that adaptive criterion weighting explains much of the benefit, with joint target-criterion inference adding further value. BASIS selects only among supplied criteria and does not discover new ones.

arxiv.title: Kwai Summary Attention V2 Technical Report
arxiv.abstract: Summary-token architectures such as Kwai Summary Attention (KSA) compress distant context into learnable Summary token per chunk, and hybrid variants interleave these layers with full attention to retain exact access to the original text. In such hybrid KSA-Full architecture, the interleaving inserted summary tokens are served as a streaming flow role across different layers. Although effective, however, it also introduce some bottlenecks: (1) the different layers summary compression chunk must be same, therefore hard to reach a flexible KV Cache compression, e.g., different layer set different summary compression chunk window. (2) in the full-attention layers, the summary token introduced additional computation cost, but such layer ignore them and still pay quadratic prefilling, therefore unfriendly to the computation side. Motivated by them, we developed the KSA V2, which not only achieves a more flexible KV cache memory compression but also reduces the computation cost in Full attention layer. Specifically, we found that the summary tokens can serve two roles: the KV memory and sparse indexer.
arxiv.titleZh: Kwai Summary Attention V2 技术报告
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 Summary-token 类注意力（如 KSA）的混合 KSA-Full 架构存在两个瓶颈：各层的摘要压缩块必须保持一致，难以实现分层灵活的 KV cache 压缩；Full attention 层仍承担二次复杂度的预填充，却未利用额外引入的 summary token。KSA V2 让 summary token 同时充当 KV 记忆与稀疏索引器两种角色，从而支持更灵活的 KV cache 内存压缩并降低 Full attention 层的计算开销。该工作为进行中的技术报告，摘要中尚未给出量化结果。

arxiv.title: Does Pretraining Teach Chemical Language Models Chemistry?
arxiv.abstract: Chemical language models (CLMs) are pretrained on large corpora of molecules with the aim of learning representations that transfer to diverse downstream tasks. Here, we systematically study the effects of pretraining using a series of such CLMs across 64 molecular property prediction datasets. We find that the downstream gains of pretraining in CLMs do not scale and performance saturates below gradient-boosting baselines. Across the regimes evaluated, only supervised pretraining on traditional physico-chemical descriptors consistently improves downstream performance for the CLMs tested whereas some forms of pretraining result in models worse than a randomly initialized encoder. While models can resolve molecular structure well, they do so no better than a randomly initialized model, suggesting that, at best, CLMs learn descriptor-like properties in addition to low-level token statistics during pretraining, but surprisingly little chemistry beyond what classical molecular features already capture.

arxiv.title: Tiny Recursive Message Passing
arxiv.abstract: Message passing neural networks have shown remarkable performance in algorithmic and constraint reasoning, due to their ability to encode the structure of the task directly in the architecture. Recent work has shown that better results can be achieved using recursive transformers trained with deep supervision and truncated recursions, which make extremely deep loops stable to train, and equipped with test-time procedures such as discrete deduction lattices. In this work, we apply the same procedures to message passing networks, and show that the two ingredients are complementary, and lead to parameter efficient models: we obtain about $99\%$ test accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme with a model of $16$k parameters that trains in about $10$ minutes on an H100, or in $9$ hours on a CPU. We further show that the cost of truncating gradients grows with the number of rounds information needs to cross the graph, making the choice of wiring a trade-off between robustness to truncation and transfer across problem sizes. We conclude by showing that our models transfer zero-shot to larger instances than those seen during training, outperforming popular neural baselines on N-queens and Boolean satisfiability with a fraction of their parameters.

arxiv.title: MultiAlloc: Budget-Aware Precision Allocation for KV Cache Quantization
arxiv.abstract: The Key-Value (KV) cache constitutes a dominant source of memory consumption during large language model (LLM) inference, particularly in long-context and complex reasoning scenarios. Existing KV cache quantization methods have explored different compression granularities, including layer-wise precision adjustment and token-level information preservation. In practical deployment, however, the key challenge is not merely compression, but how to allocate limited quantization resources among heterogeneous precision preservation strategies under a fixed KV cache memory budget. We propose MultiAlloc, a profiling-guided precision allocation framework for KV cache quantization that adaptively distributes limited quantization resources between layer-wise precision enhancement and token-wise preservation. MultiAlloc employs lightweight offline profiling to characterize layer sensitivity and token importance, enabling adaptive precision allocation under a fixed memory constraint. Guided by the profiled memory--accuracy trade-off, it automatically derives an effective precision allocation strategy without online allocation search, and applies the resulting policy during inference. Extensive experiments on reasoning and long-context benchmarks demonstrate that MultiAlloc consistently improves over layer-wise, token-wise, and recent multi-granularity KV cache quantization methods under matched memory budgets across diverse models, including Mistral, Llama, DeepSeek-Qwen, and QwQ.
arxiv.titleZh: MultiAlloc:预算感知的 KV Cache 量化精度分配

arxiv.title: To Align or Not To Align: Check Your COMPASS Before You Train
arxiv.abstract: Combining pretrained models is a common strategy for building AI systems, whether by aligning a vision encoder with a language model or merging fine-tuned checkpoints. However, finding compatible pairs typically requires costly empirical search, as compatibility is known only after alignment or merging. We propose COMPASS (COMPatibility ASsessment Score), a theoretically motivated diagnostic that estimates whether a model pair will be compatible prior to alignment or merging. Building on the observation that representational convergence is most robust at the level of local neighborhoods, COMPASS decomposes model compatibility into two cheap-to-compute axes: a pair-specific ease, defined as the $k$-NN overlap between the two encoders, and a paradigm-level ceiling, capturing the maximum overlap their training paradigms allow. Together, these two axes provide a ranking of candidate model pairs and prescribe how to act on each pair: (i) prioritize pairs that already agree and whose paradigms are compatible, (ii) invest additional compute on pairs with compatible paradigms but low initial agreement, (iii) switch the pretraining paradigm when it cannot support sufficient agreement, or (iv) deprioritize pairs that score poorly on both axes. We apply COMPASS to $72$ cross-modal alignment experiments and $392$ task-arithmetic model merges and show that compatibility estimates by COMPASS strongly correlate with downstream success, achieving average Pearson correlation of $0.91$ on cross-modal alignment tasks and $0.70$ on model merging.
arxiv.titleZh: 对齐与否:训练前先检查你的 COMPASS

arxiv.title: DTScribe: Generating Models for Digital Twin Reporting using Local Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: The development of a digital twin brings together many stakeholders and technical components. We have previously investigated the reporting of the conceptual architecture for these digital twins as an artifact for discussion. However, we find that the activity of modeling the digital twin for visualization and consensus-building can be quite tedious and time-consuming. In this article, we explore the automation of model generation using large language models, targeting the model required for digital twin reporting. Our approach is designed to ingest digital twin documents and output both the conceptual architecture visualization and a reporting page for that digital twin. We first extract from the input the key details aligning with our twenty-one-characteristic Digital Twin Description Framework described in previous work. Then, we generate a description model in the Ontological Modeling Language, representing the digital twin as a constellation of models, data, enablers, and services. We utilize refinement loops with large language models acting as judges and ontological reasoning to increase artifact quality as measured by our metrics. We investigate how architectural and parameter choices affect artifact quality, such as how refinement loops enable local large language models to produce sufficiently high-quality results comparable to larger models. We also detail insights and lessons learned useful for practitioners, such that they can integrate our techniques to accelerate their digital twin reporting or for other model generation tasks. These insights include the use of medium-sized local models (around 20 billion parameters), the avoidance of large language models as judges and clustering for characteristic extraction, and the recommendation of at least two reasoner loops for Ontological Modeling Language refinement.

arxiv.title: Geometric Calibration of Supervised Fine-Tuning
arxiv.abstract: Recent studies investigate the weight geometry through its spectral structure, which characterizes how the weights transform different input directions. Within this view, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is shown to induce dense updates that perturb the spectral geometry of pre-SFT weights along their principal directions, potentially disrupting the model's prior knowledge. These observations motivate using the geometry of pre-SFT weights as a reference for refining learned SFT updates. We study this perspective as Geometric Calibration and develop SPACE Subspace Projection for Adapted Checkpoint Enhancement), a lightweight post-hoc method that selectively reverts SFT update components within the principal subspace of the pre-SFT weights while preserving those in its orthogonal complement. SPACE is a data-free, training-free method that requires only the pre- and post-SFT checkpoints. We evaluate SPACE on Qwen2.5, Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Llama-3.1, and Olmo-3 models ranging from 2B to 14B, across mathematical, coding, and medical SFT, as well as several SFT variants. Overall, SPACE mitigates out-of-domain (OOD) capability regression while further improving in-domain (ID) performance over the uncalibrated SFT checkpoints. For math SFT, SPACE yields average ID/OOD gains of 2.85/2.26 points on Qwen2.5-7B, and 2.41/1.52 points on Qwen3-14B-Base, respectively. These results highlight how the geometric relationship between SFT updates and pre-SFT weights shapes the adapted model's capabilities and, more broadly, motivate geometry-aware parameter updates for continual model improvement.
arxiv.titleZh: 监督微调的几何校准
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 SFT 会沿预训练权重主方向产生密集更新、扰动谱几何并损害模型原有能力的问题，提出以 SFT 前权重的几何结构为参照，用子空间投影(SPACE)选择性地回退落在预训练权重主子空间内的 SFT 更新分量，同时保留正交补空间中的更新。该方法无需数据、无需训练，只依赖 SFT 前后的两个 checkpoint。在 Qwen2.5、Qwen3、Qwen3.5、Llama-3.1、Olmo-3(2B–14B)上覆盖数学、代码、医疗 SFT 及多种 SFT 变体，缓解域外能力回退的同时提升域内表现:数学 SFT 下 Qwen2.5-7B 平均 ID/OOD 提升 2.85/2.26 分，Qwen3-14B-Base 提升 2.41/1.52 分。
